title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Office Assistant
description:
# Full-Time Virtual Administrative Assistant (Remote)



## Join the Team at BMS Premier Cleaners



BMS Premier Cleaners is looking for a dependable, highly organized, and customer-focused **Full-Time Virtual Administrative Assistant** to support our growing operations. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys multitasking, providing excellent customer service, and keeping daily operations running smoothly.



If you're detail-oriented, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.



## Position Details



* **Position:** Full-Time Virtual Administrative Assistant

* **Location:** Remote

* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday (Mountain Time business hours)

* **Employment Type:** Full-Time



## Responsibilities



As our Virtual Administrative Assistant, you will be responsible for:



* Creating and sending invoices daily

* Following up with customers after completed services

* Scheduling residential and commercial cleaning appointments

* Confirming upcoming appointments

* Answering incoming phone calls,
s, and text messages professionally

* Managing customer information within Jobber

* Monitoring and responding to company
 inboxes

* Contacting customers regarding past-due invoices

* Assisting with customer service questions and issue resolution

* Coordinating technician schedules and route changes

* Creating and updating work orders and job notes

* Maintaining accurate customer records and digital files

* Assisting management with reports and administrative projects

* Performing additional office duties as assigned



## Qualifications



We're looking for someone who has:

* At least 2 years of administrative or virtual assistant experience

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

* Strong customer service experience

* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills

* High attention to detail and accuracy

* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

* Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly

* Experience using Microsoft Office and Google Workspace

* Reliable high-speed internet connection

* Quiet, professional home office environment - Must be their only job

## Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

* Jobber

* CRM or scheduling software

* Cleaning or home service industries

* Accounts receivable or invoicing

## What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

* Takes initiative without constant supervision

* Communicates professionally with customers and staff

* Works well under deadlines

* Is dependable and accountable - This is their only job.

* Has excellent problem-solving skills

* Represents our company with professionalism and positivity

## Benefits

* Full-time, stable employment

* Work from home

* Paid training

* Supportive team environment

## How to Apply

Please submit:

* Your resume

* A brief summary of your administrative experience

* Your hourly wage expectation

* Your availability to work Mountain Time business hours

* Three professional references



**Bonus:** In your application, tell us about a time you successfully handled a difficult customer or managed multiple priorities under a tight deadline.

title: Video Ads Editor
description:
About Uvora



Uvora is building an AI-first content engine that creates high-performing advertising creatives at scale. We combine AI-generated assets, avatar technology, voice generation, and performance marketing principles to produce engaging content that drives measurable results.

We are looking for a Video Editor who can transform raw assets into compelling, attention-grabbing ads designed for Meta platforms 
 & Instagram).



Responsibilities



Content Creation & Editing:

- Edit engaging short-form video ads for Meta platforms

- Transform AI-generated assets, voiceovers, and avatar footage into cohesive narratives

- Select relevant B-roll, visuals, and supporting assets that strengthen storytelling

- Create native-style social media ads that feel authentic and platform-native

- Maintain strong pacing, hook retention, and viewer engagement throughout videos



Creative Execution:

-Follow creative briefs and reference ads while adding your own creative enhancements

- Improve visual flow, transitions, timing, and overall polish

- Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines and performance objectives

- Produce multiple creative variations for testing and optimization



AI Workflow Integration:

- Work with AI voice generation tools

- Edit AI avatar videos to appear natural and human-like

- Utilize AI-powered creative tools to accelerate content production

- Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows that improve creative output



Requirements:

- 2+ years of video editing experience

- Strong portfolio of social media ads and short-form content

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing software

- Understanding of
 and Instagram advertising creatives

- Strong storytelling, pacing, and attention to detail

- Experience working with AI-generated content is a plus

- Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment



Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience creating direct-response advertisements

- Familiarity with performance marketing concepts

- Experience using AI avatar and voice generation platforms

- Knowledge of motion graphics and basic animation



Success in This Role:

You understand how to make AI-generated content feel authentic, engaging, and performance-driven while consistently delivering high-quality creative assets.



How to Apply:

Please send:

- 2–5 examples of direct-response ads you've edited (not cinematic reels)

- Your favorite ad you've worked on and why you think it performed well



We're looking for editors who understand one thing:

The goal isn't to make pretty videos. The goal is to make people stop scrolling and buy.

title: eBay Virtual Ambassador
description:
Job Title

eBay Sports Card Brand Ambassador (Virtual)

 

About Us

We operate a fast-growing sports card business selling graded and raw cards on eBay.

We handle baseball, basketball, football, and modern inserts (Topps, Bowman, Prizm, PSA, etc.).

We are looking for a long-term, detail-oriented Brand Ambassador to represent our store and manage listings, orders, and customer communication.

What You Will Do

You will be responsible for:

• Creating eBay listings from provided card photos

• Writing accurate titles and descriptions

• Finding sold comps and pricing cards

• Uploading photos and organizing inventory

• Updating sold orders and tracking numbers

• Responding to customer messages

• Managing unpaid items and returns

You will be working inside our eBay Seller Hub and Virtual Storage Drive.



Who We Are Looking For

This role is perfect for someone who:

• Has experience listing on eBay

• Understands sports cards (PSA, BGS, SGC, Bowman, Topps, Prizm, etc.)

• Knows how to find sold comps (130point, eBay sold, Terapeak)

• Is highly detail-oriented

• Has strong written English

• Wants long-term, stable work

Sports card knowledge is REQUIRED.

 

Hours & Pay

• Part-time to start (5–10 hours per week initially)

• Can grow to full-time

• Paid weekly

• Rate depends on experience

 

How to Apply

Please share your interest to

Job Overview

Position: Social Media & Content Specialist

AI Content Generation: Write engaging captions, posts, and script ideas primarily using generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.).

Graphic Design: Create aesthetic, visually engaging graphics, banners, and carousels using Canva paired with AI image generation tools.

Video Production: Produce realistic, high-quality AI avatar and voiceover videos using HeyGen and edit them for short-form video platforms (Reels, TikTok, Shorts).

Content Scheduling & Management: Organize and schedule content across various social media channels, ensuring consistent posting schedules and a cohesive visual brand.

What We Are Looking For

Strong Eye for Design: You have a natural sense of aesthetics, layout, color harmony, typography, and visual hierarchy—ensuring every piece of content looks polished and professional.

Proficiency in Core Tools:



Canva: Strong graphic design sense and layout skills.

HeyGen: Experience (or quick capability to learn) generating AI video avatars and scripts.

Great Character & Attitude: Positive, reliable, honest, and a great team player who communicates proactively.

Growth Mindset: High willingness to learn new software, workflows, and digital marketing strategies as AI technology evolves.

Technical Requirements

Stable, high-speed internet connection with a backup plan.

A reliable computer/laptop capable of handling video rendering and multiple browser tabs.

A quiet, dedicated home office workspace.

If you are eager to master the future of content creation and grow with us full-time, we’d love to hear from you!

Your updated Resume

title: Cinematic Video Editor — Slow, Atmospheric Style (Paid Test ? Ongoing)
description:
I'm launching a golf documentary-style YouTube series and need an editor with a strong sense of mood, pacing, and atmosphere. This is not fast-paced YouTube editing — it's the opposite.



The style:



Slow, intentional, cinematic. Long holds. Shots that breathe.

No fast cuts, no zoom-ins, no whip pans, no jump cuts, no 
-style editing.

Natural sound is a priority — birds, wind, footsteps, the sound of the game. Low-fi music, ambient, mood. 





Reference channels (please watch before applying): David Fragomeni, Beau Miles, Kraig Adams, Van Neistat, Erik Anders Lang / Adventures in Golf.



The paid test project:

I'll send you raw footage and a written creative brief. You'll cut a 60–90 second atmospheric piece that captures the mood. Paid regardless of outcome. Please quote your flat rate for this test.



What happens after:

The editor whose work best matches the vibe gets ongoing work editing full episodes (roughly 20–30 minutes each, from a structured timeline I provide). Steady, recurring volume.



Requirements:



Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects a plus, not required)

A real eye for pacing, mood, and composition — this is the #1 thing I'm hiring for

Comfortable working with lots of b-roll and natural sound design

Good English communication and reliable turnaround

Portfolio links required — ideally something atmospheric/documentary/travel, not fast-cut vlogs



Not needed: golf knowledge, shot tracers, or heavy motion graphics. Those are handled separately.



To apply:



Start your message with the word SUNSET so I know you read this

Send 1–2 portfolio links (say which parts you edited)

Your flat rate for the test project

title: Full Stack Web Developer – E-Commerce & API Integrations
description:
Remote | Independent Contractor | Initial 3-Month Term



We are seeking a Full Stack Web Developer to help build a scalable e-commerce platform for a growing sports card and collectibles business.



The initial focus will be developing a professional website, connecting Shopify and eBay through APIs, organizing inventory through custom SKUs, and creating the foundation for future customer and consignor dashboards.



Marketing, graphic design, and daily eBay listing responsibilities are handled by our existing operations team.



Responsibilities

Build and maintain a responsive e-commerce website.

Configure and customize Shopify.

Develop integrations between Shopify, eBay, and internal systems.

Synchronize active listings, sold items, orders, inventory status, and custom SKU data.

Design a database for inventory, customers, consignors, sales, and payouts.

Develop secure customer and consignor login access.

Create an internal dashboard for managing inventory, users, and sales activity.

Test, troubleshoot, document, and maintain the platform.

Recommend scalable and cost-effective technical solutions.

Explain technical options and tradeoffs in clear, non-technical language.



Required Qualifications

At least three years of relevant full-stack development experience, or a strong equivalent portfolio.

Experience building customer-facing web applications.

Shopify development and Shopify Admin API experience.

Strong experience integrating third-party REST APIs.

Understanding of OAuth, webhooks, JSON, error handling, and data synchronization.

Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework such as React.

Backend experience using Node.js, PHP/Laravel, Python, or a comparable framework.

Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or another relational database.

Experience with secure authentication and user permissions.

Working knowledge of Git and code repositories.

Strong written English and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with eBay APIs or another major marketplace API.

Experience with inventory, order, consignment, or customer portal systems.

Experience supporting a U.S.-based business.

Familiarity with sports cards, collectibles, or e-commerce operations.



Direct eBay API experience is strongly preferred but not required. Applicants without eBay experience should demonstrate similar marketplace or inventory integrations.



Initial Priorities

Recommend the appropriate technology stack and project plan.

Establish the website and database foundation.

Connect Shopify and eBay.

Synchronize listings, sales, inventory, and custom SKUs.

Create secure customer and consignor access.

Develop an internal administrative dashboard.

Test and document the completed system.



Not every feature is expected to be completed during the initial three-month engagement. The selected contractor will help establish realistic milestones and priorities.



Ownership and Security



All source code, documentation, accounts, databases, and project assets must remain under company ownership and control. Code must be maintained in a company-accessible repository, and confidential information must be protected.



To Apply



Please provide:



A summary of your relevant experience.

Two or three similar completed projects.

Your specific role and technologies used.

Any Shopify, eBay, or marketplace API experience.

Your recommended technology stack.

Your availability and hourly or project rate.

title: Remote Appointment Setter (SDR, Sales, Virtual Assistent, VA)
description:
If you love the fitness world, thrive on conversation, and want to be rewarded every time you turn an interested lead into a paying member, keep reading.



About Us

We are building an exclusive, high-level community for top-tier sports, health, and wellness creators. We help fitness influencers and athletes scale their impact and their business.

We are currently looking for a driven, remote Community Setter to speak with inbound leads who have already booked a call with us, qualify them, and set them up for a closer to bring them into our ecosystem.



What You'll Do

Calling Booked Leads: Working through a daily list of inbound leads who have scheduled a call after expressing interest in our community.

Following the Script: Running each call through our proven script to build rapport, uncover the lead's goals, and qualify their fit.

Qualifying: Asking the right questions to confirm the lead is a genuine match before they're passed along.

Handing Off: Booking qualified leads onto our closers' calendars, with clear notes so the closer walks in fully briefed.

Tracking: Logging every call, outcome, and follow-up to keep a clean, accurate pipeline.

Hitting Targets: Meeting clear daily and weekly targets for calls made, leads qualified, and calls booked with closers.



Note: You are not closing the sale yourself and you are not managing creators once they join. Your singular focus is qualifying inbound leads and setting them up for the close.



What We Provide

A Ready-Made Script: A proven call script and objection-handling framework — you won't be improvising from scratch.

Warm Leads: Every lead you call has already booked the call themselves — no cold outreach.

Coaching: Regular call reviews and feedback to sharpen your delivery and your numbers.

Growth: A clear progression path into closing or senior team roles for top performers.





Pay and Progression

A fixed monthly base amount, plus

Commission on every sale closed from a call you qualified and set.

Motivated setters who consistently deliver well-qualified calls can build a strong, growing income stream. Exact details of the compensation structure and progression path will be explained during the interview process.





Who You Are (You're a fit if...)

Reliable & Honest: You show up, do the work, and communicate transparently.

Highly Motivated: You're a self-starter who loves the thrill of a good conversation and hitting targets.

Culturally Plugged In: You naturally consume fitness content and understand the world these creators live in.

Coachable, Not Robotic: You can run a script consistently while still sounding human and adapting to the person on the other end of the line.

Equipped: You have reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to work.





Requirements

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable running back-to-back calls off a set schedule.

Consistent daily availability for scheduled calls and follow-ups.





How to Apply

Apply here: 
/t/6ni393yCWvus

title: SEO/AI Search Optimization & GEO Expert
description:
For over 21 years, Altos has partnered with hotels and resorts to help them stand out, connect with travelers, and drive more direct bookings. We’re looking for a part-time SEO/AI Search Optimization & GEO expert (10–15 hours per week) who understands the ins and outs of getting discovered in AI search.



The Role:

- Research and optimize content for AI-driven and traditional search experiences.

- Optimize Google Business Profiles, schema markup, and local listings.

- Analyze visibility trends and identify opportunities for growth.

- Support content strategy with AI-friendly formatting, keyword alignment, and metadata.

- Build and monitor link equity through outreach and partnerships.

- Help shape and manage client reputation and review response strategies.

- Create clear, actionable performance reports.

- Stay ahead of search evolution — from SGE to local algorithm updates.



Requirements

-A minimum of 5 years of experience in SEO, local SEO, and now digital visibility in AI search 

-Deep understanding of search intent, schema markup, and local ranking factors.

-Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, and related tools.

-Understanding about AI search tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.).

-Excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail.

-Ability to manage multiple clients within part-time hours.

-Hotel experience a plus.



Please note: This is not a traditional SEO role and it's not an entry-level role. Only candidates with demonstrated experience and knowledge of AEO/GEO practices and the evolving best practices to increase visibility in AI search need to apply. We are in need of an expert who has been staying ahead of where search is going. 



If you are that expert-level candidate, please submit your resume, along with a  minimum of 2 work examples of your SEO/AEO/GEO work, and a short note about why you're the right fit for this position. 



Thank you, in advance, for your interest.

title: Remote HVAC recruiter
description:
Join Our Team!



Tiger Air & Heating is a growing HVAC company in Dallas, Texas, and we're looking for an energetic recruiter who loves finding great people.



This is **not** a job where you simply post ads and wait for applicants. We're looking for someone who enjoys searching for candidates, reaching out, following up, and building relationships.



You'll recruit HVAC technicians, installers, office staff, dispatchers, and customer service representatives using platforms like OnlineJobs.ph,
, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other recruiting sources.



## Pay & Bonuses



* $3.00- 5 per hour based on experiance

* Performance bonuses for successful hires who remain with the company



If you're good at finding quality candidates, you'll have the opportunity to earn additional bonuses.



## Responsibilities



* Source and recruit candidates every day.

* Post job ads when needed.

* Search
 groups, OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other websites.

* Contact potential candidates through messages and phone calls.

* Screen applicants.

* Schedule interviews.

* Follow up with candidates.

* Keep recruiting organized and updated.

* Help us continuously improve our hiring process.



## Qualifications



* Excellent English, both written and spoken.

* Strong communication skills.

* Organized and dependable.

* Comfortable making outbound calls and sending messages.

* Recruiting, sourcing, sales, customer service, or HR experience is preferred.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.



---



## Before You Apply



To help us get to know you, please submit:



* Your resume.

* A **30-60 second voice recording or video** introducing yourself (a voice recording is perfectly acceptable if you prefer not to be on camera).



Please tell us:



* Your name.

* Where you live.

* Your recruiting experience.

* Why you'd like to work with Tiger Air & Heating.



---



## Application Questions



Please answer the following:



1. Tell us about your recruiting experience.

2. What recruiting platforms have you used?

3. Have you recruited skilled trades or technical positions before?

4. Are you comfortable making outbound calls and following up with candidates every day?

5. Do you currently work for any other clients?

6. How many hours per week are you available?

7. If hired, when could you start?

8. Why do you think you'd be a great fit for this role?



We look forward to meeting you!

ByShameel is a garment research and fashion product development studio working with culture-led brands across fashion, streetwear, gymwear, athlete/influencer brands, artist merchandise, lifestyle, sports, and e-commerce.



The studio helps brands develop stronger products through product direction, apparel design, technical documentation, material direction, and development clarity.



ByShameel works with brands that already have motion - audience, sales, cultural relevance, upcoming launches, or product development needs - and helps turn unclear product ideas into stronger, more defined product systems.



About the Role:

ByShameel is looking for a Business Development Coordinator / Lead Research Specialist to support lead research, CRM organization, and pipeline development.



This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, strong at online research, and interested in fashion, e-commerce, streetwear, creator brands, and culture-led businesses.



The: Business Development Coordinator / Lead Research Specialist will help identify potential client opportunities, research brands and decision makers, organize lead information, track business signals, and support outreach preparation.



This is a research and coordination role designed to support business development. It is not a sales closing role.



Why This Role Matters:

ByShameel is building a more consistent business development system around a growing studio.



This role will help create structure around the pipeline by identifying qualified brand opportunities, organizing lead information, tracking follow-ups, and helping ensure the studio is consistently aware of strong potential clients.

What You’ll Do:

- Maintain and update lead information inside a CRM or spreadsheet

- Organize lead details including brand name, website, social links, contact information, segment, status, notes, and next steps

- Help evaluate whether a lead is relevant based on brand fit, timing, audience, product opportunity, and business signals

- Support outreach preparation by suggesting relevant context or angles for potential conversations

- Track follow-up dates and help keep the business development pipeline organized

- Prepare weekly lead research summaries and pipeline updates



What We’re Looking For:

- 2+ years of experience in lead research, business development support, sales support, market research, CRM management, sales operations, or a related role

- Proven experience researching and qualifying leads, not just collecting contact information

- Strong online research skills across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, websites, and e-commerce stores

- Strong written English and ability to summarize research clearly

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, or similar CRM/spreadsheet tools

- Ability to identify relevant business signals such as launches, product drops, hiring activity, founder growth posts, audience traction, or product-development needs

- Ability to research and organize decision makers such as founders, creative directors, product leads, brand managers, artist managers, or agency contacts

- Comfortable working independently and managing recurring weekly tasks

- Strong time management and ability to provide clear updates

- Interest in fashion, streetwear, gymwear, e-commerce, creator brands, artist merchandise, lifestyle brands, or culture-led businesses



Preferred Experience:

- 3–5 years of experience in lead generation, business development support, market research, CRM management, sales operations, or virtual assistance

- Experience supporting founders, agencies, creative businesses, e-commerce companies, or service-based studios

- Experience researching fashion, apparel, streetwear, gymwear, e-commerce, DTC, creator, artist, or lifestyle brands

- Experience preparing qualified lead lists, prospect notes, pipeline reports, or weekly research summaries

- Experience using CRM tools or structured lead tracking systems

- Familiarity with Shopify stores, Instagram brand research, TikTok research, LinkedIn prospecting, and founder/contact research

- Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar tools for research, summarization, organization, and workflow support



Tools & Work Style:

This role may involve using tools such as Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Shopify stores, Google Search, and AI-assisted research tools.



The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, asking clear questions when needed, and turning online research into organized, useful information.



We are looking for someone who can think critically, spot patterns, and understand why a lead may be relevant — not just gather names and links.

- Flexible schedule

Please submit your resume, a short cover letter, and a 1–2 minute video introduction (Google Drive, Dropbox and etc is fine)

title: Moodle LMS Administrator and Digital Operations Contractor
description:
About Green Training USA



Green Training USA is a nationally accredited online training provider for building performance and energy efficiency certifications, including BPI, RESNET HERS Rater, LEED, radon, mold, and continuing education. Our students are HVAC contractors, energy auditors, and building professionals across the country. Everything we deliver runs online, which means our learning management system and our website are not support functions. They are the business.



Role summary



We are looking for one experienced contractor to be our go-to person for three connected areas of work: our Moodle learning management system, our website, and our marketing video and social media content.



This is not an entry level role and it is not a role for someone learning Moodle on our dime. Moodle does not behave like Teachable, Thinkific, Kajabi, or a standard WordPress LMS plugin. It has its own course structure, its own activity and resource logic, its own gradebook behavior, its own completion tracking rules, and its own way of breaking. We need someone who already knows that system in their hands and can move through it quickly without needing to be walked through the basics.



The right person is independent, responsive, and accountable. You will be given a task and a deadline, and we expect it to come back done, tested, and correct.



Engagement structure



Read this section carefully before applying. It is the part most people skim and then get frustrated by later.



This is an independent contractor position, not employment. You control your own hours, your own equipment, your own taxes, and your own business.

Work is as needed. When we have a project, we contact you, describe the scope, and agree on payment and a deadline before work begins.

Pay fluctuates by task. A quick course edit and a full course build are not the same job and will not be priced the same. We will ask for your rate structure by task type.

You would be our primary contractor for this category of work. We expect to send you work frequently. We are being honest with you that we cannot guarantee volume, and no minimum number of hours or projects is promised.

Your schedule flexes to our needs. We are not asking you to sit and wait by the phone, but we need reliable responsiveness when we reach out.

Projects will sometimes be routine and planned. Others will be urgent, such as a course that has to be live before an enrollment deadline or a site issue affecting students who have already paid.

Core responsibilities

1. Moodle learning management system (primary)

Build and upload new courses, including full course shells, sections, topics, and navigation

Edit and update existing courses, including content revisions, restructuring, and replacing outdated material

Upload and configure course content: SCORM packages, video, PDFs, pages, books, files, folders, and external tool links

Build and maintain quizzes, question banks, exam settings, attempt limits, time limits, randomization, and grading rules

Configure activity completion, course completion, prerequisites, and restrict access conditions so students move through material in the correct order

Manage the gradebook, including categories, weights, aggregation methods, and grade item setup

Set up and troubleshoot certificate issuance and completion credentials

title: Creative Strategist / Direct-Response Copywriter — US Health Brand ($10/hr, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US



We're a US direct-to-consumer health supplement brand, scaling fast. We sell to a skeptical, older American audience — people 55 to 75 who have a drawer full of supplements that promised everything and delivered nothing. Winning their trust is hard. That's the job.



We run aggressive direct-response creative on Meta: video ads, UGC scripts, native advertorials, static ads.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Research our buyer until you know them better than they know themselves — their exact language, their fears, what almost stopped them from buying

Study competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library and work out WHY the winners win. Not what they say — why it works.

Propose which angles and ads we build next, with the reasoning and the data behind it

Write the scripts: video briefs, UGC, native advertorials (800–1500 words), static concepts

Read performance data and tell me what it means

Flag when we need a landing page or an
 angle — and propose the structure



You are the thinking mind of the creative. You propose the play. You don't wait to be told the play.



REQUIREMENTS — all of these, not most of them



Minimum 2 years writing direct-response copy. Not brand copy. Not blog posts. Not social captions. Copy written to sell, where you saw the numbers afterward.

You can write a full long-form advertorial — 1000+ words that hold a reader who didn't intend to read anything. If you've only written short-form, you're not ready for this role.

You understand the metrics. ROAS, CAC, payback period, LTV, MER, hold rate. Not as vocabulary — as things you've used to make a decision.

You can tell a symptom from a story. "I get tired in the afternoon" is a symptom. "I promised my granddaughter I'd be at her birthday, and I made it forty minutes before I went and sat in the car" is a story. If that distinction isn't instantly obvious to you, please don't apply.

You follow instructions precisely. If I ask for five pieces, I get five. If I ask for a scene, I get a scene. This is the single most common reason people don't last here.

Strong written English. Native fluency isn't required. Precision is. If your application has sloppy errors, that's the answer.

You take feedback once. I'll correct something once, clearly. I won't correct it three times.



DO NOT APPLY IF



You need every task explained twice

You use AI to write and hope nobody notices

You go quiet when you're stuck instead of asking

You want to write "nice" content. Our register is aggressive. If your draft feels safe and could belong to any supplement brand, it's wrong.

You're juggling five other clients and this is filler



WHAT YOU GET



$8-10/hour, 4 hours a day to start, Monday to Friday. More hours available as you prove out.

Long-term. We're building a team, not filling a gap.

Real training, real feedback, access to our real performance data

You'll learn direct-response at a level most people never get exposed to



HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. Most applicants won't, and that's the first filter.



1. Start your application with the word HYDROGEN in the subject line. No HYDROGEN, no reply.



2. Answer these three questions. Short is fine — thinking matters more than length:



What's the difference between an angle and a benefit? Give me one example of each.

Name one ad — any brand, any product — you think is genuinely well written, and tell me in two or three sentences why it works.

Why do most supplement ads fail with a skeptical 65-year-old buyer?



3. Write me ONE opening scene. Just one. Two or three sentences.



The person: a man, 62, who feels a lot older than he is. He's low on energy by mid-afternoon and has written it off as age.



Do NOT describe his tiredness. Write the 
nt it cost him something. A specific person, a specific place, a specific 
nt, and something he lost. Do not use the words "tired," "energy," or "exhausted" anywhere.



4. Send one writing sample of long-form direct-response copy you wrote yourself. An advertorial, a sales page, a VSL script. If you don't have one, this role isn't a fit yet.



5. Tell me honestly whether you used AI for any part of this application. We can tell. An honest yes is far better than a no we don't believe. AI-written applications go straight in the bin.



We reply to every application that completes all five steps. We don't reply to the ones that don't.

title: Customer Service Representative - Home Services (ServiceTitan Preferred)
description:
REMOTE CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE - RESIDENTIAL HVAC & PLUMBING



We are a growing U.S. residential HVAC and plumbing service company looking for a dependable, warm, and highly organized Customer Service Representative. You will be one of the first voices our homeowners hear and an important part of a long-term team.



This is a full-time position for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, stays calm under pressure, and wants to build a lasting relationship with one company.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Answer inbound calls from U.S. homeowners with empathy, urgency, and professionalism.

- Ask focused questions, identify legitimate service demand, and work toward a booked appointment.

- Create and update accurate customer, location, job, and appointment records.

- Leave clear notes so dispatch and technicians have the information they need.

- Give customers honest updates and follow through on promised next steps.

- Make occasional outbound follow-up calls when assigned.

- Coordinate closely with dispatch and other tea
mbers. The CSR captures and books demand; dispatch d
 technician routing.

- Help protect phone coverage, call quality, and the customer experience during busy periods.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent spoken and written English for phone-based customer service.

- ServiceTitan experience is heavily preferred. Please describe exactly how you used it.

- Residential HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other U.S. home-services experience is strongly preferred.

- Strong experience with appointment booking, a CRM, or U.S.-based customer service may qualify if you learn software quickly.

- Calm judgment with upset customers and the ability to turn a difficult call into a clear next action.

- Accurate notes, dependable follow-through, and a team-first attitude.

- A quiet home office, quality headset, reliable high-speed internet, backup internet, and a practical backup-power plan.

- Ability to work this shift exclusively, without another job overlapping the scheduled hours.

- Interest in a stable, long-term working relationship.



SCHEDULE



- Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time.

- 40 paid hours per week: eight paid hours per day with no unpaid lunch. Brief paid breaks are coordinated around phone coverage.

- U.S. and Philippine holidays and company-closure days are regular workdays unless approved PTO is used.

- Very rare weekend coverage may be requested. It would normally replace a weekday. A true sixth workday requires a separate agreement and additional pay.



COMPENSATION AND PTO



- $7 USD per paid hour, paid for 40 hours per week.

- 15 paid-time-off days per year, accrued from day one at 1.25 days per month.

- PTO is normally available after 90 days; genuine emergencies may be considered earlier.

- This offer does not include a 13th-month payment.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and answer the application questions thoughtfully. Shortlisted applicants will receive instructions through OnlineJobs.ph for a recorded, approximately 10-minute AI phone interview. A human makes every hiring decision. If you need an accommodation or an alternative interview format, tell us in your application.



Please do not send a generic application. We especially want to understand your ServiceTitan experience, home-services experience, examples of handling upset customers, booking judgment, reliable work setup, and why you want a long-term role.

description:
# Recruitment Coordinator



## Overview



We are a fast-growing chess coaching company operating in over 100 primary schools across multiple counties, with continued expansion planned over the next year.



We are looking for a highly organised and proactive Recruitment Coordinator to help manage coach recruitment, onboarding and safer recruitment processes across the company.



This is a key operational role requiring excellent communication skills, strong organisation and the ability to manage multiple recruitment processes efficiently and professionally.



---



# Key Responsibilities



* Managing coach recruitment from application through to onboarding

* Screening candidates and arranging interviews

* Conducting interviews with prospective coaches

* Supporting safer recruitment and safeguarding processes

* Managing DBS tracking, references and recruitment documentation

* Coordinating onboarding and training schedules

* Handling recruitment-related
s and communication

* Maintaining organised recruitment records and databases

* Scheduling interviews, training sessions and operational meetings

* Working closely with the operations team to ensure staffing requirements are met

* We would also like you to be responsible for scheduling our coaches and ensuring smooth running of the clubs throughout the term.



---



# Requirements



We are looking for someone who is:



* Absolutely fluent in spoken and written English

* Highly organised and detail-oriented

* Smart, proactive and able to think independently

* A strong problem solver

* Hard-working and reliable

* Comfortable managing multiple tasks and deadlines

* Professional and confident communicating with candidates and staff

* Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

* Experienced using
, spreadsheets and online systems

* Able to maintain confidentiality and professionalism at all times



---



# Working Hours



* Monday to Friday

* Available during UK working hours



---



# Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate will have experience in recruitment, administration, HR coordination or operations support and will be comfortable working in a growing business environment.



Experience with safeguarding or safer recruitment processes is beneficial but not essential.



---



# About Us



We provide chess coaching programmes to primary schools and are passionate about delivering high-quality, professional and reliable services to schools, parents and pupils.



As we continue to grow, we are building a strong operational team to support our coaches and schools across all areas of the business.

We are a growing CPA firm seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented bookkeeper to join our team. This position offers the opportunity to work remotely with diverse clients while maintaining full-charge bookkeeping responsibilities.

We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper with extensive QuickBooks Online (QBO) expertise to manage our clients' financial records. You will work with clients across various industries, performing monthly bookkeeping cycles, cleanups, and catch-up work.

* Conduct bookkeeping cleanups and catch-ups for clients with backlogged records

mbers regarding financial matters

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis)

mbers

* Excellent organizational and time management skills with ability to meet deadlines

* Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment

* Reliable high-speed internet connection and professional home office setup



Preferred Qualifications



* QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification

* Certified Bookkeeper (CB) or similar professional certification

* Experience working with U.S.-based clients and familiarity with U.S. tax regulations

* Knowledge of 1099 and W-9 compliance

* Experience with other accounting software platforms (Xero, Sage, NetSuite)

* Background working with CPA firms or accounting practices



Application Requirements



To apply for this position, you must submit a 2-3 minute video addressing the following questions. This video submission is mandatory and will be used to assess your communication skills, technical knowledge, and fit for the role.



Video Questions:



1. Tell us about yourself and your bookkeeping background. Briefly describe your professional experience, including how many years you've worked in bookkeeping, the types of clients or industries you've served, and what aspects of bookkeeping you find most rewarding.



2. Describe your QuickBooks Online experience. Explain specific tasks you've performed in QBO (e.g., setting up Chart of Accounts, managing classes/locations, running reports, handling multi-currency transactions). Share an example of a complex QBO challenge you successfully resolved.



3. Explain your process for handling a bank reconciliation discrepancy. Walk us through the specific steps you would take if you discovered a $500 discrepancy while reconciling a client's bank account. How would you investigate and resolve it?



4. Describe a bookkeeping cleanup or catch-up project you've completed. Tell us about a client who came to you with backlogged or disorganized books. What was the situation, what steps did you take to clean it up, and what was the outcome?



5. Why are you interested in this position, and why should we choose you? Share what attracts you to working with a CPA firm and what unique skills or qualities you would bring to our team.



Video Submission Guidelines:



* Keep your video between 2-3 minutes in length

* Ensure clear audio quality and professional lighting

* Record in a quiet, distraction-free environment with a professional background

* Speak clearly and at a moderate pace

* Dress professionally as you would for an in-person interview

* Look at the camera to maintain "eye contact" with viewers

* Be authentic and let your personality and professionalism shine through



How to Apply



Please submit your application including:



1. Your video response (2-3 minutes) answering the questions above

2. Your resume highlighting your bookkeeping experience and QBO expertise

3. Any relevant certifications (QuickBooks ProAdvisor, Certified Bookkeeper, etc.)



We look forward to learning about your bookkeeping experience and how you can contribute to our growing team. Applications without video submissions will not be considered.

Highly organised. Running three or more mailboxes at once, at volume, without losing track of anything

Sound judgement about when to answer and when to ask

Discretion — you'll have access to confidential client information and target company details

Reliable internet, since you'll be working through a remote desktop connection all day

Working hours



We need meaningful overlap with UK business hours so that replies land the same working day. Our preference is a shift running into the UK morning and afternoon. We'll discuss the exact pattern at interview.



Nice to have

Experience in customer support, executive assistance, sales development or inbox management

Familiarity with Smartlead, Instantly, Outlook or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Exposure to professional services, finance or B2B sales

Details

Full-time, 40 hours per week

$500–700 USD per month, with the final figure to be confirmed based on experience and shift pattern

Paid monthly, long-term contract, performance reviews at 3 and 12 months

Fully remote, remote access and setup provided

How to apply



Send your CV along with a short note on your relevant experience — in particular any role where you managed inboxes or communicated on someone else's behalf.

title: Join Leverage Agent as a Recruitment Specialist!
description:
Help Build World-Class Virtual Teams for US & Canadian Businesses



Leverage Agent is a fast-growing Virtual Assistant services company providing highly skilled remote professionals to businesses throughout the United States and Canada. We specialize in connecting exceptional talent with businesses in industries such as Real Estate, Construction, Healthcare, Marketing, Finance, and Professional Services.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Recruitment Specialist who is passionate about finding top talent and creating an outstanding candidate experience.



If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys interviewing people, and has a keen eye for identifying A-Players, we'd love to meet you.



Position



Recruitment Specialist (Full-Time | Remote)



What You'll Do



As a Recruitment Specialist, you'll take ownership of the entire recruitment lifecycle, including:



Talent Sourcing

Source qualified candidates through job boards, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and other recruitment channels.

Build and maintain a strong pipeline of candidates for current and future openings.

Create compelling job advertisements that attract high-quality applicants.

Candidate Screening

Review resumes and applications.

Conduct initial phone and video interviews.

Evaluate candidates based on communication skills, experience, personality, and cultural fit.

Verify employment history, references, and qualifications.

Recruitment Management

Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and clients.

Maintain accurate candidate records within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

Provide timely updates to candidates throughout the hiring process.

Manage multiple hiring projects simultaneously.

Collaboration

Work closely with Operations, Client Success, and Hiring Managers to understand staffing needs.

Recommend recruitment strategies to improve hiring speed and candidate quality.

Assist with onboarding and pre-employment documentation.

Continuous Improvement

Track recruitment KPIs and hiring metrics.

Recommend improvements to recruitment processes and workflows.

Stay updated on hiring trends, sourcing techniques, and recruitment technology.

Qualifications

Required

Minimum 2 years of recruitment experience, preferably in Virtual Assistant, BPO, or remote staffing.

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills.

Experience sourcing candidates using multiple recruitment platforms.

Ability to manage multiple job openings simultaneously.

Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

Self-motivated and able to work independently.

Strong time management and follow-up skills.

Preferred

Experience recruiting Virtual Assistants for US or Canadian clients.

Experience hiring for Real Estate, Executive Assistant, Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Operations, or Administrative roles.

Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, JobStreet, OnlineJobs.ph, Upwork,
 Groups, or similar sourcing platforms.

Experience with personality assessments or structured interviewing methods.

Technical Requirements

Reliable high-speed internet connection

Quiet, professional home office

Laptop or desktop computer capable of handling video interviews

Webcam and quality headset

Backup internet connection is a plus

What Success Looks Like



Successful Recruitment Specialists consistently:



Fill open positions efficiently without sacrificing quality.

Deliver an exceptional candidate experience.

Build strong talent pipelines.

Maintain organized recruitment records.

Meet hiring deadlines.

Present only high-quality candidates to clients.

Continuously improve recruitment processes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Time-to-fill positions

Number of qualified candidates sourced weekly

Interview-to-hire ratio

Offer acceptance rate

Candidate quality score

Hiring manager/client satisfaction

Recruitment pipeline health

Candidate response time

Job fulfillment rate

. After your video is reviewed, you may be contacted by our hiring team and asked to complete a test assessment.

title: Video Editor for Educational Pickleball Content
description:
Hey! 

I run Her Pickleball Pathway — an online pickleball coaching community (Skool) with a YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok 
 shoot the raw footage; I need a reliable editor to turn it into polished, on-brand video content every month, ongoing.

This is a long-term part-time role, not a one-off gig. If it's a good fit on both sides, there's room to grow into more hours as the channel grows.



BENEFITS INCLUDE

- 100% remote, work on your own schedule (async — no fixed daily hours required)

- Ongoing, ~20–30 hours/month to start, with room to grow as the channel grows

- Clear brand kit and reference examples provided before you start — no guessing what I want

- Straightforward monthly workload, not unpredictable one-off requests

- Direct communication with the owner (me) — no layers of management



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Long-form (4/month):

- Edit 4 educational YouTube videos per month (3–5 min each) — clean cuts, captions, brand intro/outro, light graphics/lower-thirds per my brand kit.

Teasers (4/month):

- Cut down each of those same 4 videos into a shorter teaser — hook + partial lesson, ending on a clear CTA to join Her Pickleball Pathway on Skool for the rest.

Short-form (16/month, 4 per week):

- Edit original short-form clips (<30 sec) for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts — hook-driven, fast-paced, captioned, vertical (9:16).

Thumbnails (4/month):

- Design 1 custom YouTube thumbnail per long-form video in Canva, matching my brand kit — clear, high-contrast, click-worthy.



EXPECTED VOLUME (part-time, ~20–30 hours/month)

- 4 long-form YouTube videos/month

- 4 teaser cutdowns/month

- 16 short-form clips/month (4/week)

- 4 YouTube thumbnails/month

- Total: ~24 finished deliverables/month



PAID TRIAL FIRST

Before the ongoing role starts, I'll run a small paid trial with 2–3 shortlisted candidates: 1 long-form video + its teaser, 2 shorts, and 1 thumbnail, paid at a pro-rated rate. Whoever's trial work is the best fit gets the ongoing role.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

Experience & portfolio:

- Proven short-form editing experience — you know how to hook a viewer in the first 1–2 seconds, not just make clean cuts

- Portfolio links showing: short-form social edits, a long-form YouTube edit, and (ideally) a YouTube thumbnail you've designed

- Bonus: experience editing sports, fitness, or coaching content



Tool competence:

- Strong in at least one of: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

- Comfortable designing in Canva for thumbnails

- Can follow a brand kit consistently — fonts, colors, intro/outro, caption style — across every edit



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong English proficiency (written and spoken) — you'll be reading my raw footage notes and writing on-screen text/captions

- Reliable, responsive communicator who hits deadlines without heavy hand-holding

- Quiet workspace and stable high-speed internet for uploading/downloading large video files



TECH REQUIREMENTS (MINIMUM)

- Computer capable of running your editing software smoothly (Premiere/DaVinci/CapCut) alongside cloud drive syncing

- At least 8–16 GB RAM and enough free storage to handle monthly video batches

- Stable internet for large file uploads/downloads



SCHEDULE & COMMUNICATION

This is async, deadline-based work — no fixed daily hours. You'll get raw footage on a monthly batch (long-form) and weekly batch (shorts), and deliver on the turnaround windows below. I'm based in Phoenix, Arizona (Pacific/Mountain time), so real-time overlap with Philippines hours is limited — we'll keep a shared Google Drive and async messaging as the primary workflow, with an occasional async check-in.

- Long-form videos + teasers + thumbnails: delivered within 1 week of the monthly raw footage batch

- Weekly shorts (4/week): delivered within 2–3 business days of each week's footage

- Revisions included until you're happy with the edit — please send all notes for a video in one batch



HOW TO APPLY

To confirm you've read this whole post, start your application with the word “DINK.” Applications without it won't be considered.

- A short intro — who you are and what kind of editing you focus on

- 2–3 portfolio links (short-form edits, a long-form YouTube edit, and a thumbnail if you have one)

- Your availability (hours/week) and whether $600–$800/month works for the ~24 deliverables/month described above

- Confirmation you're open to the small paid trial before the ongoing role starts

 

A full brand kit (colors, fonts, caption style, tone, reference videos, and CTA requirements) will be provided to the selected editor before the first batch of footage.

title: RMA Specialist
description:
Job Description: RMA Specialist 

note: Tesla experience is non-negotiable.



Position Summary

The RMA (Return Material Authorization) Specialist is responsible for managing the complete warranty replacement process for defective solar equipment from initial diagnosis through final resolution. This role serves as the primary point of contact between manufacturers, internal departments, and field service teams to ensure warranty claims are processed efficiently and customers receive timely resolutions.

The ideal candidate has prior experience managing the RMA process within the solar industry and is highly familiar with Tesla Energy products, including navigating Tesla's warranty and service processes. Experience with additional manufacturers such as Enphase, SolarEdge, Qcells, FranklinWH, or similar is preferred.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Warranty & RMA Management

? Manage warranty replacement (RMA) cases from initiation through closure.

? Submit, track, and manage RMAs through Tesla and other manufacturer warranty portals.

? Review warranty eligibility and ensure all manufacturer requirements are met prior to submission.

? Monitor approvals, equipment shipments, backorders, and replacement timelines.

? Escalate delayed or critical warranty cases with manufacturers as necessary.

Technical Coordination

? Collect and verify all required diagnostics, photos, monitoring data, and troubleshooting documentation before submitting warranty claims.

? Work closely with Service Technicians to confirm proper troubleshooting has been completed.

? Coordinate with Engineering, Operations, Service Coordinators, and Procurement to ensure seamless execution of replacement activities.

? Schedule replacement work with Service Coordinators and Area Service Managers once replacement equipment is received.

Quality Assurance

? Verify successful equipment replacement through remote monitoring platforms (Tesla One, Enphase Enlighten, SolarEdge Monitoring, etc.).

? Confirm systems are operating properly before closing warranty cases.

? Ensure accurate documentation of labor, parts, serial numbers, and warranty records.

Communication

? Serve as the primary point of contact for manufacturers regarding warranty claims.

? Provide timely updates to internal stakeholders on RMA status, shipment tracking, and expected completion dates.

? Communicate professionally with service personnel and management regarding case progress.

Process Improvement

title: Direct response video editor for e-commerce brand
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)



DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$200k/month in revenue 



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type: 



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage. 



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.
