title: Brand Operations Manager- Product Launch and DTC
description:
## About the Role



JLSelby is building a private portfolio of founder-led consumer businesses connected to the products, knowledge and capabilities of an established American agricultural operation.



We are hiring a full-time **Brand Operations Manager** to take responsibility for moving one assigned company from founder direction through product readiness, offer development, Shopify launch and early market exposure.



This is not a virtual-assistant position.



It is a high-ownership operating role for someone who can take an incomplete business, organize the work, coordinate specialists and vendors, solve problems and drive it toward a real commercial launch.



You will report to the JLSelby portfolio leadership team. You will work with outside manufacturers, product specialists, designers, developers, fulfillment providers and marketing contractors.



You will not be expected to personally perform every specialist task. You will be expected to make sure every task has an owner, deadline, standard and completed result.



## What You Will Own



You will be assigned primary operating responsibility for one founder-created consumer company.



Depending on the assigned company, you may coordinate:



* Business and launch planning

* Product development and testing

* Manufacturer and supplier research

* Packaging development

* Product costing and pricing

* Vendor quotations and comparisons

* Brand and creative production

* Offer and bundle development

* Shopify store preparation

* Fulfillment and customer-service readiness

* Launch campaigns and early market testing

* Weekly budgets, milestones and performance reporting



Your job is to move the business forward without requiring the founder to personally organize and follow up on every step.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Convert Founder Direction Into Execution



* Organize founder notes, product concepts and decisions

* Convert broad direction into a clear operating plan

* Establish workstreams, priorities, owners and deadlines

* Maintain the company’s launch calendar

* Identify missing information and resolve it quickly

* Prevent work from remaining open without action



### Manage Vendors and Contractors



* Research manufacturers, suppliers and specialist contractors

* Request quotations, samples and production information

* Compare cost, quality, lead time, capacity and risk

* Prepare recommendations instead of forwarding unorganized options

* Assign and track contractor deliverables

* Follow up consistently until work is completed

* Confirm that all source files and work product are delivered to JLSelby



### Coordinate Product and Supply Readiness



* Maintain product-development and testing schedules

* Coordinate prototypes and samples

* Track packaging, labels and component requirements

* Organize cost-of-goods and minimum-order information

* Coordinate quality, compliance and specialist review

* Track production and inventory timelines

* Help establish fulfillment and 3PL readiness



Specialist technical support will be provided when required. You will own coordination and completion.



### Prepare the Company for Shopify



* Coordinate the Shopify build

* Organize product information, pricing and offers

* Coordinate product photography, copy and creative assets

* Confirm payment, tax, shipping and fulfillment setup

* Prepare customer-service and return procedures

* Coordinate
 capture and essential
 flows

* Test checkout, mobile display and order processing

* Confirm that the business is commercially ready before marketing begins



### Prepare the Company for Exposure



* Maintain the launch offer and target-customer brief

* Coordinate landing pages and advertising assets

* Work with creative and growth specialists

* Organize launch-test budgets and timelines

* Track customer response and commercial evidence

* Report what is working and what is not

* Recommend whether the company should continue, revise, pause or accelerate



## How You Will Report



Your weekly operating update should answer:



1. What was completed?

2. What is due next?

3. What is blocked?

4. What evidence did we learn from customers, vendors or the market?

5. What decision is required?

6. What do you recommend?

7. Is the company on schedule and within budget?



We do not want long activity reports.



We want concise facts, recommendations and completed results.



## What Success Looks Like



### During the First 30 Days



* Understand the assigned company and its commercial purpose

* Organize all existing notes, files, contacts and decisions

* Create a clear launch plan

* Identify the major missing requirements

* Establish responsible parties and deadlines

* Begin resolving the most important constraints



### During the First 60 Days



* Have qualified vendors and contractors actively working

* Establish reliable product, packaging and cost information

* Organize the customer, product and preliminary offer

* Maintain an accurate launch-readiness tracker

* Resolve routine problems without unnecessary founder involvement



### During the First 90 Days



* Materially advance the company toward commercial launch

* Demonstrate effective vendor and contractor management

* Produce completed deliverables and commercial evidence

* Show strong judgment about priorities and spending

* Operate with limited daily supervision

* Make a clear recommendation to continue, revise, hold or accelerate



## Required Characteristics



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have at least four years of operations, project-management, startup or e-commerce experience

* Can turn ambiguity into an organized operating plan

* Have managed contractors, vendors or remote tea
mbers

* Communicate clearly and professionally in English

* Follow through without repeated reminders

* Prepare recommendations rather than merely reporting problems

* Are comfortable making reasonable decisions within defined authority

* Can manage several workstreams at once

* Understand that activity is not the same as progress

* Are willing to challenge, revise or stop weak work

* Work well in a founder-led and rapidly changing environment

* Can create simple systems without creating unnecessary bureaucracy



## Valuable Experience



Experience in any of these areas is helpful:



* Shopify

* Amazon

* Consumer products

* Product launches

* Contract manufacturing

* Packaging development

* Food, beverage, personal care or wellness products

* Inventory and fulfillment

* E-commerce marketing

* U.S.-based clients or founders

* Remote international teams

* AI and automation tools

* Google Sheets or project-management systems



You do not need to be an expert in every category. You must know how to find, evaluate and manage capable specialists.



## This Is Not the Right Role If You:



* Wait for detailed instructions before acting

* Primarily want administrative or executive-assistant work

* Report problems without recommending solutions

* Avoid difficult vendor follow-up

* Need a large established corporate structure

* Create meetings and reports that do not move work forward

* Treat deadlines as optional

* Need continuous daily supervision

* Are uncomfortable being measured by completed results



## How We Work



JLSelby is founder-led, direct and entrepreneurial.



We value:



* Urgency without chaos

* Independent thinking

* Clear responsibility

* Simple operating systems

* Honest reporting

* Commercial judgment

* High standards

* Respectful accountability

* Completed work



We are quietly building something substantial. We are not interested in corporate theater, unnecessary jargon or excessive meetings.



## Employment Details



* Full-time remote position

* 40 hours per week

* Long-term opportunity

* Regular overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

* Compensation of $1,500–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience

* Initial paid probationary period

* Opportunity to advance into Senior Brand Operations Manager or General Manager of an individual company



Applicants must disclose all other current employment, clients and ongoing time commitments.



## How to Apply



Begin your application with:



**QUIET BUILDER**



Applications that do not begin with those words may not be reviewed.



Please provide:



1. A concise summary of your relevant operating experience

2. One example of a business, product or project you organized from an unclear or early stage

3. The number and types of vendors, contractors or tea
mbers you have managed

4. Your experience with Shopify, e-commerce or physical products

5. A system or process you personally created

6. Your current employment and other clients

7. Your availability to begin

8. Your available Philippine working hours

9. Your required monthly compensation

10. A project you recommended changing, stopping or deprioritizing and why



## Practical Exercise



Answer the following in no more than one page:



You are assigned a new premium consumer-product company. The founder has a product concept, several pages of notes and preliminary packaging ideas. There is no final manufacturer, approved budget, completed offer or Shopify store. The goal is to begin a controlled commercial test within 120 days.



Explain:



* What you would do during the first two weeks

* Which workstreams you would establish

* What information you would need from the founder

* What you would personally own

* What you would assign to specialists

* Which decisions require executive approval

* What could prevent the 120-day launch

* How you would report progress



We are looking for practical judgment, clear priorities and evidence that you can move real work forward. Generic answers will not be competitive.

title: Construction Estimator for NYC Luxury Renovation Company
description:
Prime Renovations is a boutique general contracting firm in Manhattan specializing in high-end renovations of co-op and condo apartments. Our projects typically range from $700K to over $3M. We're a small, systems-driven team, and this is a long-term role for someone who wants to grow with us, not a one-off project.



The Role



You'll own the estimating workflow from plan set to bid-ready proposal. Day-to-day, that means:



Performing quantity takeoffs from architectural drawings (demolition, framing, drywall, millwork, tile, flooring, paint, electrical, plumbing fixtures, and finishes)

Building estimates in our CSI-organized cost catalog in Excel, applying our markup structure

Managing bids in Procore: sending bid invitations to subcontractors, tracking responses, and leveling sub quotes

Requesting and comparing supplier pricing for materials

Following our documented SOPs and flagging where they can be improved



Requirements



2+ years of construction estimating experience, residential preferred

Experience doing takeoffs from real architectural plan sets using PlanSwift, Bluebeam, STACK, or similar (we use PlanSwift)

Strong Excel skills: you're comfortable with structured workbooks, formulas, and keeping a cost database clean

Able to read US construction drawings and specifications

Strong written English; you'll communicate with subs and suppliers

Available to overlap at least 4 hours with US Eastern time

Reliable internet and a computer that can run takeoff software



Nice to Have



Experience with US residential work, especially apartments, interiors, or renovation (not just new build)

Procore experience

Familiarity with CSI divisions



How to Apply



Start your application with the word GRANITE so I know you read this. Then answer these three questions. Applications that skip them will not be considered.



Describe the most recent takeoff you completed: project type, scope, which software you used, and roughly how long it took you.

Have you estimated US-based residential projects before? If yes, describe one.

List every estimating and takeoff tool you've used, and rate yourself 1 to 10 on Excel.



Shortlisted candidates will be offered a paid test: a takeoff from one of our actual plan sets.

Manage TrueCommerce/EDI account oversight; direct Ops Admin on portal execution

title: Shipping Software Developer
description:
About GoodGoods



GoodGoods is a Rotterdam-based B2B logistics intermediary. We pool shipping volume from multiple webshops to negotiate better rates with carriers including PostNL, DHL, DPD, bpost, CIRRO/GOFO, and Dragonfly. We manage purchase rates, sales rates, and surcharges across carriers and countries, acting as a broker between our merchants and the underlying carrier network.



The project



We are building our own shipping orchestration platform: a system that sits between external partners (Sendcloud, Deliverymatch, Zineps, WMS platforms such as Picqer and LyraWMS) and the carriers/brokers we work with. Partners call our platform with shipment details (destination country, weight, dimensions, cutoff time); our platform d
, based on our own contracts and rate tables, which carrier and service level offers the best price/quality match, and returns the final shipping label. End customers only ever see GoodGoods — the underlying carrier or broker is never exposed.



This is a from-scratch build. The end-state architecture is mapped out (see the attached plan), but the first deliverable is a tightly scoped MVP: one carrier, one partner integration, and a rule-based rate engine, running fully end to end. The full data model is designed up front so later phases (multiple carriers, brokers, an admin UI, self-service partner onboarding, automated invoice reconciliation) can be added without a rebuild.



What you'll build (MVP scope)



In scope



Full Supabase (Postgres) schema for the end-state platform (partners, merchants, carriers, brokers, carrier methods, purchase/sales rates, contracts, shipment requests, rate decisions, shipments, tracking events, carrier invoices, audit log), even though only part of it will be populated at MVP stage.

One carrier adapter built to a uniform interface: createLabel, cancelLabel, getTracking, getServiceCapabilities.

A rule-based rate engine (v1): filters on country/weight/dimensions and picks the lowest allowed sales price within the active contract, built as an isolated, testable module.

A partner-facing REST API (POST /v1/rates/quote, POST /v1/shipments, GET /v1/shipments/{id}, cancel, tracking) with API-key authentication scoped per merchant.

Label generation/normalisation (PDF/ZPL) returned under GoodGoods' own reference and tracking number.

Basic tracking ingestion from the carrier (webhook or polling), normalised into a shared status set.

Append-only audit logging and idempotency keys from day one; all monetary values stored as integer cents.



Explicitly out of scope for the MVP



Broker sub-routing layer (the adapter contract is designed to support it later).

Internal admin UI for contracts/rates — managed via Supabase Studio / seed scripts for now.

Automated invoice reconciliation — existing spreadsheet-based workflows continue in parallel.

Self-service partner onboarding — new API keys are issued manually.

Integration with the existing customer portal (separate Next.js/Supabase app, currently in beta).

Responsibilities

Design and implement the Postgres schema in Supabase, including Row Level Security for partner/merchant isolation.

Build the first carrier adapter end to end against a real (sandbox) carrier API.

Build the rule-based rate engine as a separately testable module, with unit tests.

Build and document the partner-facing API (Next.js on Vercel) with authentication and per-merchant scoping.

Set up tracking ingestion and status normalisation.

Set up audit logging and idempotency handling from the first commit.

Work with the GoodGoods team to validate rate logic against real contract data (rate cards, surcharges, minimum volumes).

Use Claude Code as day-to-day build support, and keep the codebase in a state where it can be picked up by future developers.

What we're looking for



Must-have



Strong experience with TypeScript/Next.js in production, ideally on Vercel.

Solid Postgres experience, comfortable designing a normalised schema from a written spec.

Experience with Supabase (or willingness to ramp up quickly — Postgres + Edge Functions + RLS).

Experience building and securing external-facing REST APIs (auth, scoping, idempotency).

Comfortable integrating with third-party/carrier APIs (labels, tracking, webhooks).

Able to work independently from a written architecture document and ask sharp clarifying questions.



Nice-to-have



Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, or shipping/carrier integrations (PostNL, DHL, DPD, bpost, or similar).

Experience with rule engines or pricing/rating logic.

Experience with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development workflows.

Dutch language skills (useful for reading existing carrier contracts, not required for the codebase).

How we'll work together

Start from the attached architecture plan and MVP scope; first milestone is a working end-to-end flow (request ? decision ? label) for one carrier and one partner.

Short async check-ins on progress; ad hoc calls with the GoodGoods pricing/operations team (Rowan, Azhar) to validate rate logic.

Codebase and schema decisions documented as we go, so the platform can grow into later phases (more carriers, brokers, admin UI, invoice reconciliation, customer portal integration) without rework.

title: 3D Artist / Motion Designer Wanted
description:
Project Overview: I am a livestreaming musician looking for a talented 3D Artist / Motion Designer to build a series of highly atmospheric virtual stages. These will serve as pre-rendered video backgrounds behind a physical green screen using Ecamm Live to broadcast weekly live virtual concerts. Since the performance changes and evolves each week, and new shows with different stage backgrounds are in production, the right candidate could be employed consistently for roughly 10 hours a week or more for the long-term. 



The core aesthetic for this project is a vast, eerie cathedral or ancient monastery (dark gothic architecture, towering arches, stained glass, dimly lit corridors). A central element of this stage will be a mystical, magical video projection integrated into the environment and a single performer playing guitar and keyboards integrated seamlessly into the virtual stage. 



Key Responsibilities:

 • 3D Environment Modeling: Design a grand, gothic cathedral or monastery interior featuring large pillars, stone textures, and dramatic architectural depth.

 • Virtual Screen Integration: Seamlessly embed a 16:9 aspect ratio projection area into the cathedral background that plays video files provided by me. The screen should be styled as a magical, mystical projection (e.g., hovering ethereal mist, a magical energy field, or glowing ancient runes) rather than a modern LED wall.

 • Multi-Angle Perspective: Distort and skew the embedded 16:9 video playback window so it realistically matches the perspective and depth of a few different camera angles focused on the performer.

 • Lighting & Animation: Create eerie, moody light shows (flickering candlelight, moonlight piercing through stained glass, pulsing low-light columns, and lasers) looped to a steady tempo.

 • Atmospheric Visual Effects (VFX): Integrate thick volumetric stage fog, floating dust motes/particles, and realistic light shafts to create a haunting sense of scale.

 • Seamless Rendering: Export perfectly looping video files with zero visible cuts or jumps upon looping.



Required Skills and Qualifications:

 • Expertise in Blender, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, Autodesk Maya or whatever software gets the job done. 

 • Strong portfolio showcasing gothic, dark fantasy, or grand historical 3D environments.

 • Experience embedding external video textures/materials into a 3D environment with proper perspective warping.

 • Deep understanding of volumetric lighting, god rays, and atmospheric fog rendering.

 • Ability to structure the composition to leave a clear "performer pocket" in the center frame.



Technical Deliverables:

 • Format: MP4 or MOV

 • Resolution: 1080p (16:9 aspect ratio).

 • Framerate: 30fps

 • Duration: 30-to-60-second seamless loops.



Application Process & Screening Test

To be considered for this position, please reply with the following information:

 • A link to your portfolio, ArtStation, or video reel highlighting your best dark fantasy, gothic, or realistic 3D environments.

 • Your preferred 3D creation software.

title: Administrative & Customer Support Specialist with GoHighLevel Automation Experience.
description:
We are hiring an assistant with proven experience and a strong background in wearing multiple hats. However, please note that this is not your usual VA role.



We need someone who thinks beyond assigned tasks, takes initiative, and actively contributes to solving problems rather than just executing instructions.



This is a full-time, long-term position for someone who is organized, coachable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly.



ROLE OVERVIEW

You will work directly with our Filipino VA as a dependable partner, supporting the team across various areas of the business and day-to-day operations.



This is best for someone who can show grace under pressure, help keep things organized, communicate clearly, and follow through on tasks.



If you are resourceful, self-motivated, and confident in taking ownership of outcomes without being micromanaged, you may be the right fit for this role.



WORKING HOURS

• Full-time position

• 40 hours per week

• EST/EDT

• Remote setup



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Communicating with clients and teammates through CRM, Slack, and WhatsApp

• Managing schedules, calendars, follow-ups, and day-to-day admin tasks

• Handling ad hoc tasks as needed

• Completing projects that help the business run smoothly and continue growing



QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills

• Good organization skills and strong attention to detail

• A coachable attitude and willingness to improve

• The ability to think outside the box and complete tasks efficiently

• Initiative to figure things out independently

• A desire for long-term employment, not a part-time or temporary role

• Proven experience with GoHighLevel, AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), Google Workspace, Canva, and executive assistance



TECHNICAL AND WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

• Laptop or desktop with at least a 10th-gen i5 processor and 16 GB RAM

• High-speed and stable internet connection

• A backup internet connection (strongly preferred)

• Quiet, professional workspace (dual monitor strongly preferred)

• Noise-canceling headset

• Backup power source or a contingency plan for outages (strongly preferred)



COMPENSATION

• $7 per hour

• Paid bi-weekly

• Payment cycle: every 10 working days



HOW TO APPLY

• Please use ZT as your subject line and use 10 AP points.

• Submit a link to your CV/Portfolio using Google Drive.

• Include a short video recording of yourself speaking in English. Introduce yourself, explain why you would be a good fit, and include any relevant work experience.

• Make sure we can access and view the file. We won't request access.



IMPORTANT

• Applicants who do not follow the instructions will be immediately disqualified and will not receive a reply.



HIRING PROCESS

• Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

• Qualified applicants will be invited for a 30-minute to 1-hour interview.



If you are looking for a stable, long-term role with room to grow your skills and increase your compensation over time, we look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Book Editor / Reviewer for AI-Written Victorian & Regency Stories (Long-Term)
description:
We write original Victorian and Regency stories with the help of AI, and we need a sharp human editor to review each book before it moves into production. AI writes the draft. Your job is to make sure it reads like a real book written by a real author - not something a machine produced.



You do not need to be a professional book editor. We are looking for someone with a strong love of reading, excellent English, and a sharp eye - anyone who could catch the things that pull a reader out of a story.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Read each full book and review it the way a real editor would.

- Catch inconsistencies: plot holes, character mix-ups, name or timeline errors, things that contradict earlier chapters.

- Flag anything that does not make sense or breaks the logic of the story.

- Spot "AI tells" - robotic phrasing, repetitive patterns, generic wording, jargon, or anything that sounds artificial or unnatural.

- Make sure the writing feels authentic, human, and true to the tone of a Victorian/Regency story.

- Check that the English is clean, natural, and reads well.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

- Someone who skims and gives it a thumbs up.

- Someone who runs it through a grammar tool and calls it done.

- Surface-level proofreading with no attention to story, sense, or authenticity.



MUST-HAVE

- Excellent English - near-native reading and writing, with a strong sense of natural phrasing.

- A sharp eye for inconsistencies, continuity errors, and things that "don't add up."

- The ability to tell when text sounds AI-generated versus genuinely human.

- A real reader - you enjoy books and know what makes a story work.



NICE TO HAVE

- Interest in the Victorian and Regency era.

- A fan of Bridgerton-style stories and period romance/drama.

- Editing, proofreading, or writing experience.



THE WORK

- Genre: Victorian and Regency stories.

- This is the review step that happens before a book goes into video/audiobook production.

- Volume: roughly one book per month to start, with room to grow over time.

- Long-term: we want one dependable reviewer to grow with us, not a one-off freelancer.



PAY

- $10 per book reviewed. Paid through Wise in USD.

- Long-term, ongoing role with room to grow as our volume increases.



HIRING PROCESS

- Apply (see below).

- Selected applicants will be asked to review a short sample - part of an actual book - so we can see whether your eye matches what you describe.

- Strong reviewers move on to a full paid test.

- From there, we select our long-term editor.



HOW TO APPLY

- Tell us about your reading and any editing/writing experience.

- Describe your English level and how you learned it.

- Tell us your favorite books or genres - and whether you enjoy the Victorian/Regency era.

- Tell us your availability and whether you can commit long-term.



We read every application. Generic copy-paste replies will not be considered.

title: Klaviyo Account Manager (Flow Implementation, Reporting and Account Operations)
description:
ABOUT US



We are an
 and SMS retention marketing agency working with 60+ active DTC brands across health, beauty, supplements, apparel, pet care, and telehealth.



We run primarily on Klaviyo, with additional work on 
, Iterable, and Attentive.



We are systematized. Locked copy formats, banned word lists, per-brand rules, and a 30-format campaign library. This role sits at the centre of the operation. When it runs well, everything downstream runs on time.







THE ROLE



This is the person who makes sure things are actually live, actually accurate, and actually reported. It is high volume and it is deadline driven. You will be handling batches of 15+ brands in a single request and you will be asked, often, what is outstanding and by when.



The two things that matter most in this seat are accuracy and follow-through. A number that is off by one client on the month-end sheet becomes a billing problem. A flow that sits in draft becomes lost client revenue.







WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. LAST 30-DAY REVENUE REPORTS (the most frequent request in this role)



- Build last-30-day revenue reports on request, in batches of anywhere from 4 to 18 brands at a time

- Report total generated, split flows versus campaigns, then calculate the performance percentage against that brand's specific rate and state the retainer alongside it

- Rates differ per brand. Some are 10%, some are 5%. You check, you do not assume

- Show the math. Converts times average order value where the platform does not attribute directly, such as Iterable accounts

- Evidence every figure with a screenshot link

- Handle pro-rated reports when a client starts or ends mid-month

- Track brand renames so reports stay continuous when a client rebrands



2. MONTH-END MASTER SPREADSHEET



- Duplicate the master sheet and set it up for the new month. Never edit the previous month's tab

- Update every client number for the month

- Add every client onboarded in the last 30 days, and double check that nobody has been missed

- Remove churned brands so the sheet stays clean

- This sheet feeds invoicing. A missing line is a missing invoice



3. WEEKLY REPORTS



- Build the weekly Klaviyo performance report per brand into Google Docs with screenshots

- Reconcile against the live account and correct manually when attributed revenue shifts after the fact

- Include subscription started and cancelled sections for the brands that require both



4. FLOW IMPLEMENTATION



- Take approved Figma designs and load them into Klaviyo or 
, then set them live

- Slice each
 correctly so images render sharp, not as one compressed block

- Set triggers, filters, conditional splits, and dynamic sections

- Configure sender address, sending domain, footer snippets, alt text, campaign UTMs, discount codes, and destination links

- Follow the designer's established fonts, colours, and format for that brand across every flow

- Resolve client comments left on Figma and transfer files when a build is complete

- Set to draft for review first, then live once approved

- Flag anything you are unsure about, such as a non-standard trigger, rather than guessing and shipping it



5. FLOW AUDITS



- Audit the live flows on an account and produce a document with screenshots covering each flow, what is broken, what is missing, and how it can be improved



6. CAMPAIGN IDEATION AND COPY ACCURACY



- Produce three ideas per brand in our locked format: one pain solution, one educational, one benefits driven

- Each block carries a headline, subheader, tight body, CTA, live product URL, full design direction, and trust badges, using a named format from our format library

- Base ideas on what is actually performing in the account, pulled from the platform data

- Verify every claim, price, offer, and guarantee against the live brand site before it goes into ideation. This is the single highest-risk point in the role. Misinformation traces back to here

- Do not repeat an angle a brand has already run, and do not build ideas for products that are sold out or brands that are paused

- Assign copy batches to the copywriters a day ahead and review what comes back



7. CLIENT STATUS TRACKER



- Maintain the pinned tracker covering every newly onboarded client

- Per client: onboarding date, whether flows are live and running, whether campaigns are scheduled every other day, what date campaigns are scheduled through, whether the sign-up form is installed and live, the platform, and the deadline

- Keep it current. When asked for status, you answer from the tracker, not fro
mory



8. TO-DO LIST AND DEADLINE DISCIPLINE



- Maintain a running to-do list with a status marker and a committed completion date on every item

- Every task you get tagged in goes on the list, immediately

- Send an updated list on request, and proactively when priorities shift

- When a date slips, say so before it slips, not after



9. TEAM FOLLOW-UP



- Follow up with the other builders on their tasks and report their status upward

- Chase what is stuck. Things falling through the cracks is the failure mode this role exists to prevent



10. ACCESS AND ASSET GOVERNANCE



- Request, confirm, and track Klaviyo, Shopify, 
, and Attentive access per account, and escalate blockers instead of letting work sit

- Grant teammates channel and Figma access when needed

- Work exclusively from the company account. Nothing lives on a personal drive

- Maintain the brand asset sheet: site URL, VOC and ICP docs, Instagram,
, Drive folder

- Keep the active versus paused client list current



11. SEND HYGIENE



- Suppress active subscription customers from campaign sends on subscription brands so we are not marketing to people already on recurring billing

- Audit accounts for under-sending against active contact counts



12. SALES AND PROOF ASSETS



- Compile Klaviyo and Shopify performance screenshots meeting our thresholds, currently $200,000+ in revenue and 15%+
 revenue share

- Write up brand case studies and maintain the full client list with links







WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required

- 2+ years managing Klaviyo accounts for DTC ecommerce brands, agency side strongly preferred

- You have loaded flows into Klaviyo from design files and set them live yourself, including triggers, filters, conditional splits, and dynamic content

- Strong spreadsheet accuracy. You will be doing percentage and retainer math that feeds invoicing, across dozens of accounts, every month

- You can hold a to-do list with dates and report against it without being chased

- You verify before you send. Claims, prices, links, offers, codes, numbers

- You can write. You will be producing campaign briefs and copy

- Comfortable in Figma at a working level: reviewing designs, slicing assets, resolving comments

- Shopify familiarity, including how the integration syncs

- Written English strong enough for internal docs and client-facing reports

- Reliable overlap with North American hours



Strongly preferred

- 
, Iterable, or Attentive experience

- Experience handling 20+ accounts at once

- Subscription platform familiarity: Recharge, Skio, Loop, Seal, Kaching

- Experience in supplements or telehealth, where claim language is restricted

- Experience following up with and coordinating other tea
mbers



How you work

- You send a status update before you are asked for one

- When you are unsure about a trigger or a setup, you say so and tag for help rather than guessing and shipping it

- You add tasks to your list the 
nt they are assigned

- You hand off a written pending-task list before time off

- You follow a locked format without needing to be reminded what it is







PRACTICAL



- Full time, remote

- Overlap with North American hours required

- Tools: Klaviyo, 
, Shopify, Figma, Google Sheets and Docs, Slack

- Compensation based on experience and the number of accounts you can hold







========================================

QUALIFYING QUESTIONS

========================================



SCREENING



1. How many Klaviyo accounts have you managed at one time? What was the highest number you held simultaneously?



2. Have you personally loaded a designed
 into Klaviyo and set the flow live, or has someone else always done the build? Describe your last one.



3. Which of these have you set up yourself in Klaviyo: triggers, flow filters, conditional splits, dynamic content blocks, snippets, UTMs, discount codes? List only the ones you have done, not observed.



4. What other platforms have you worked in: 
, Iterable, Attentive, Postscript, anything else?



5. Rate your spreadsheet skills honestly. Have you ever owned a recurring report that fed billing or invoicing?



6. What is your time zone, and what hours can you reliably overlap with North America?





*** HOW TO APPLY ***



*You must include your favorite color + animal in the subject line of your application for it to be considered (this shows you actually read it and is very important; if you do not have it in there, your application will be skipped).



1.) Send us a message answering all 6 questions

2.) Include examples of your
 copy work (formatted copy preferred, not screenshots)

3.) Include a before-and-after example showing raw AI output versus your final edited copy, if you have one



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: AI Visibility & Conversion Expert

…and more importantly, convert that traffic into enquiries and sales?

We are an Australian branding and website agency looking for an AI Visibility & Conversion Expert to help grow both Studio1 and our clients' businesses.



Your Mission

-  Help Studio1 and our clients become more visible online...

-  Then help convert that visibility into leads, sales and revenue.

You'll help optimise and improve:

-  Our website (
) and our clients' websites

-  Brand reputation across the web



You'll also:

-  Improve organic search visibility

-  Optimise websites for AI search and Large Language Models (LLMs)

-  Improve click-through rates

-  Increase website conversions



Traffic means nothing without conversions, so you'll be comfortable using tools like:

-  Yoast SEO 

-  Microsoft Clarity

-  Google Analytics 4

-  Google PageSpeed Insights

-  Ahrefs, Semrush, or Screaming Frog



You'll know how to:

-  Set up conversion tracking

-  Read heat maps and session recordings

-  Identify friction points

-  Recommend improvements

-  Create clear monthly traffic and conversion reports

-  Turn data into actionable recommendations



You don't need to be a developer, but you should understand and work with:

-  WordPress

-  Meta titles

-  Meta descriptions

-  Schema markup

-  Internal linking

-  Technical SEO fundamentals

-  Page speed basics

-  XML sitemaps

-  Indexing and crawlability

-  Structured data



If something needs implementing, you'll either do it yourself or work with our developers.



AI-First Workflows. We're looking for someone who embraces AI. You regularly use any or all of these AI tools:

-  Claude

-  ChatGPT

-  Gemini



You know how to use AI to work smarter, not just faster. Ideally, you already use:

-  Claude Skills & Claude Co-worker to generate AI-powered automations and reports, analyse data and improve workflows.



You'll fit in well at Studio1 if you:

-  Love solving problems and rarely accept "it can't be done" as the final answer.

-  Take ownership and proactively look for ways to improve traffic, conversions, systems and workflows.

-  Care about delivering measurable results for clients—not just completing tasks.

-  Enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas and helping your teammates succeed.

-  Are creative, curious and willing to challenge conventional thinking.

-  Love learning, experimenting with new AI tools and sharing your discoveries with the team.

-  Have high standards and genuinely care about producing world-class work.

-  Can communicate technical concepts clearly with both clients and teammates.



About Studio1

-  We've designed over 2,000 websites and have evolved into an AI-first growth agency.

-  Everything we do is built around one goal: Helping businesses become the obvious choice online.

-  We combine strategy, branding, websites, AI, content and conversion optimisation into one proven growth system.



To apply, please send: 

- A cover letter explaining why this role excites you

- A link to your CV

- Examples of websites or businesses you've helped grow

-  Analytics reports or case studies (if available)



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a Zoom interview.



All successful hires begin with a fully paid 4-week trial (40 hours/week). If it’s a great fit, we’ll offer you a permanent role.



Good luck =)

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor - For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have





VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here





You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer



This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:





Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us





How to apply



Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.





Portfolio. Link 3–5 ad edits you're proud of. DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred. If something ran and performed, tell us the result.

Your workflow. Walk us through how you go from brief to final cut. What do you ask for? What do you need? How do you handle unclear direction?

Your AI work. Include at least one example where you generated or integrated AI video. Higgsfield examples are a bonus.

Logistics. Your availability and timezone.





The trial task



This role comes with a paid-style trial task — and it's where you really win it. If you're hungry for this, don't wait to be asked: complete it, edit the result, and send it in with your application.

title: eCommerce CX & Operations Manager
description:
Remote | Must work U.S. Eastern Time hours | $12–18/hr USD depending on experience



About the role



We're a growing Shopify DTC brand. We're hiring one person to build our customer experience function, keep our Shopify catalog accurate and current, and manage our day-to-day relationship with our 3PL.



This is a builder role. The helpdesk exists (Gorgias, including an AI agent) but the function — the team, the playbook, the standards — is yours to create. We use AI daily (Claude is part of our stack) and expect you to use it the same way: drafting, documenting, and automating repetitive work.



What you'll own



The CX function

> Build it: hire, train, and manage a small remote support team as we grow — starting hands-on in the queue yourself

Run Gorgias as a system: macros, rules, tagging, SLAs, AI agent configuration, and reporting

> Set the standard: brand voice in every reply, documented SOPs for every scenario, escalation paths that don't route through the founder

> TikTok Shop CX: platform SLAs, disputes, seller-score protection



The Shopify catalog — you are the source of truth

> Upload and edit products: titles, descriptions, images, variants, pricing, tags, collections

> Keep the catalog accurate: if it's wrong on the site, it's yours to catch and fix

> Execute launches and updates handed to you by the founder/marketing — quickly, completely, and without errors





The 3PL relationship

> Day-to-day liaison with our 3PL via ShipHero: order holds, address changes, returns, and shipment issues chased to resolution

> Investigate inventory discrepancies between Shopify and the warehouse and get the counts corrected

> Flag fulfillment problems (delays, packaging, receiving errors) early — with what happened, what you did, and what you need





Weekly reporting — you keep leadership informed without being asked

> Deliver a weekly CX + operations report covering: tickets opened/closed and resolution times, CSAT, orders shipped and delivered, recurring product issues (defects, sizing, damage-in-transit patterns), returns, and open fulfillment problems with their status

> Numbers plus judgment: not just what happened, but what's trending, what you fixed, and what needs a decision from leadership

> Use Claude and the reporting built into Gorgias/Shopify/ShipHero to produce this efficiently — the report should take you an hour, not an afternoon





How we measure success

> CX: first-response and resolution times within SLA, CSAT, and recurring ticket types reduced through better macros, help content, and SOPs. 

> Catalog: zero-error product listings and fast turnaround on uploads and edits. 

> Fulfillment: issues resolved without founder involvement, and inventory counts we can trust. Reporting: a weekly report delivered on time, every week, that leadership can act on without asking follow-up questions.



Requirements

> Experience running customer support for a Shopify eCommerce brand, including hiring or training support staff

> Builder-level Gorgias experience: rules, automations, tagging, AI agent — not just replying to tickets

> Hands-on Shopify catalog work: you've personally created and edited products, variants, and collections

> Experience working with a 3PL or warehouse (ShipHero strongly preferred)

> Experience producing regular reports for leadership (CX and/or operations metrics)

> Daily, practical use of AI tools in your real work

> Excellent written English — this is a writing-heavy role

> Reliable availability during U.S. Eastern business hours





How we hire

Application form ? short interview ? paid practical exercise using realistic scenarios from our actual store ? reference checks. 



Please note: when the application form asks where you heard about this role, answer "Joy" — this helps us track applications correctly. We verify everything claimed in the application during the interview and exercise, so be precise about what you personally did versus what your team did.



APPLY HERE:

title: Software Engineer – Backend (AI / Agentic Systems)

Experience with LLM APIs, prompt/context design, and RAG pipelines

Solid grasp of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and microservices

title: Video Editor with AI Image & Video Generation Experience — Long-Form Story Videos (Long-Term)
description:
We write original books and bring them to life as long-form story videos - narrated audiobooks paired with visuals generated and edited by you. AI is the main tool for this work, but it is not the only tool. If you think this job is stitching together AI images with a "butterfly" zoom effect and a voiceover on top, this is not the role for you.



We are doing AI storytelling the right way. The number one goal is that our videos never read as "AI slop" or inauthentic content. That is why real video editing skill matters as much as AI generation skill.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Generate the visuals for each book: AI images and AI video clips (expect 100+ generated assets per project, sometimes more).

- Edit them into a finished long-form video: transitions, filters, color/image treatment, pacing.

- Add sound effects, background music, and (later) dialogue to match the story.

- Focus your best AI video work on the first minute or so - the hook - to grab and hold the viewer. The rest leans more on strong images and clean editing.

- We provide the narration/voiceover (the audiobook), the script, and support files. You produce the video around it. We do not hand you a script and disappear - we support the work.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

- Slideshows of AI images with a single effect slapped on top.

- Someone who only knows one AI tool and one prompt style.

- Mass-production "AI content farm" output. That era is over.



MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE (both are critical)

- Real video editing experience - you can edit, treat footage, use transitions/filters purposefully, mix SFX and music, and make a video feel authentic and intentional.

- Strong AI image and video generation experience - you know which models are best for which job, how to write high-quality prompts, how to vary angles and composition, and how to push AI tools to their full potential. This is not beginner knowledge.

- You understand that model choice affects quality - but you also know the model is not the only thing. Skill and judgment carry the rest.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience producing long videos (2-4 hours, sometimes longer).

- Sound design / music selection sense for storytelling.

- Familiarity with keeping content authentic and avoiding AI-detection/inauthentic-content flags.



THE WORK

- Video length: 2-4 hours, sometimes more.

- Volume: one video per month to start. We plan to increase volume over time, but this is not a mass-production role - quality comes first.

- We won't expect you to deliver the final video in one day or two. It will take time (probably around two weeks to have a completed version), perfect for someone who wants to manage the gig with other gigs.

- Long-term: we want one dependable video editor to grow with us, not a one-off freelancer.

- We will provide the AI tool for the right person.



PAY

- $35 per finished video. Payment through Wise in USD.

- Long-term, ongoing role with room to grow as our publishing volume increases.

- We have other channels, for the right person we can have other videos to edit from these channels.



HIRING PROCESS

- Apply (see below).

- Selected applicants will be asked to create a short 1-minute sample - a segment from a real story - so we can see whether your actual output matches what you describe. A portfolio alone is not enough; anyone can borrow files.

- Strong performers move on to a full paid test project.

- From there, we select our long-term video editor.



HOW TO APPLY

- Tell us your experience with video editing AND with AI image/video generation.

- List the specific AI models and tools you use, and why you choose them for different jobs.

- Share any past work you can (links). We will still verify skill through the sample.



We read every application.

title: Property manager/ Operations Manager/project manager for Property management company
description:
Can you take a problem you've never seen before and figure out how to solve it? That's the person we're looking for.



We manage a growing portfolio of long-term residential and commercial rental properties in Minnesota. We need a resourceful, organized operator to take ownership of day-to-day operations: someone who thinks a step ahead, closes the loop, and makes sure work moves from "reported" to "done" without being chased.



We care more about how you think than about your exact job history. Some of our best people have come from executive assistant, operations, and hospitality backgrounds, not just property management. If you're sharp, organized, and a fast learner, we'll teach you our systems. We are not looking for a simple task-doer; we want someone who can be given a problem, think through the steps needed to solve it, and come back with the resources and solutions to do so.



**Growth-Minded & Solutions-Focused:** We don't dwell on problems; we find solutions. We want people who are hungry to learn, grow, and improve our systems every day.



**Positive Energy:** Property management sometimes involves surprise challenges. Pipes burst, tenants stop paying. It is critical that we approach our work with a positive attitude. We value collaboration, open communication, and a "can-do" spirit.



**A Relationship, Not a Transaction:** We want a years-long partnership where you feel supported, trusted, and empowered to make decisions.



**Impact Over Activity:** We value outcomes. You won't be micromanaged; you will be given clear goals and the freedom to execute, along with the support to be able to succeed.



This role will be 40 hours per week, once fully trained. Your compensation will reflect your experience, initiative, growth, and contribution to the business's success.



**Schedule:** Starting schedule will be Sunday and Monday 9-5PM, Tuesday-Thursday 8AM-4PM US East Coast hours.



**What you'd own:**



**Operations (60%):**

The "Loop-Closer": When a task comes in, you manage the communication, the schedule, and the reporting in 
 and in daily report-outs to the team. Your job is to make sure work moves from "reported" to "fully completed" as efficiently as possible, and that everyone involved has what they need to do their jobs.



Tenant communication, coordinating repairs and vendors, lease renewals and lease compliance, rent tracking and follow-up on outstanding balances, coordinating with housing assistance agencies, preparing eviction documentation when needed, move-in and move-out procedures and inspections, and keeping everything moving in 
.



**Systems and finance (20%):** You are confident with numbers, bookkeeping software, and general bookkeeping. You coordinate with our accountant to ensure any questions they have are answered so our books stay accurate. You support the build of new systems and initiatives, as well as handling invoices, expense tracking, owner statements, paying invoices, updating tenant ledgers, and working within our financial SOPs.



**Communication (20%):** Warm, calm, and professional with tenants, contractors, and owners. You respond promptly, warmly, and correctly to tenant maintenance requests and contractor messages. You know how to present yourself in a warm, calm, professional manner no matter the situation, including when a conversation is difficult.



You'll thrive here if you're proactive and detail-oriented, comfortable making decisions without being micromanaged, hungry to learn, and looking for a long-term partnership rather than a transaction.



**Must have:** reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and comfort working US hours.



**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:**



3+ Years working in a US-Based Business with operations responsibility.



**Fluency in English:** Confident in multi-person meetings, initiating phone calls, and in non-scripted situations in English.



**The "Loop-Closer" DNA:** You live by the 24-hour no-update rule. If a project is open, you provide an update before we have to ask.



**Financial Rigor:** Proven experience with accounting or bookkeeping, ideally for rental properties.



**Highly Detail-Oriented and Organized:** Able to track tasks across multiple properties and follow up on outstanding issues. Skilled at prioritizing tasks based on urgency and importance.



You have a positive growth mindset.



**Strong communication skills:** you are a proactive communicator who doesn't wait to be asked for updates. You're eager to participate in ongoing discussions about improving communication protocols and systems, and receptive to feedback.



**The Tech Stack:** While we use REIhub and 
, we value your property management and accounting experience over your specific software experience. If you are an expert in the industry and familiar with competitor tools (Innago, AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi), we can train you on our specific stack.



**MUST HAVE reliable internet connection with backup.**



Proficiency with Google Drive, WhatsApp, and ability to quickly learn 
.



**A note on AI:** we use it too, so use whatever tools help you. We ask one thing in return: be straight about what you've actually done and how you actually communicate.



**HOW TO APPLY:**



To verify your attention to detail and financial expertise, please follow these steps exactly:



**Subject Line:** Include the name of the original bass player for the Grateful Dead.



**Cover Letter (Paragraph 3):** Include the phrase "closing the loop."



In your response, confirm you are available for the days and times described in this position.



Please answer the following questions in your coverletter

:

1) Describe a specific time you solved a contractor or tenant problem without waiting for direction. How did it start, what steps did you take, how was it resolved?



2) Briefly describe your past accounting/bookkeeping work. Specifically: which software have you used?



3) At any 
nt you'll have multiple open items running across different properties, say a repair waiting on a contractor, a tenant who owes rent, and a move-out inspection all live at once. Two things: (1) What system or tools do you personally use to track these so nothing slips and everyone gets an update before they have to ask? (2) When you can't get to everything, how do you d
 what comes first? Give a real example that shows both in action.

**AI:** Tell us two things: how you used AI to put this application together, and how you'd use it in the day-to-day of this role.



Please include a resume or summary to showcase your background. If you have professional recommendations from previous US-based employers, or video introductions, we encourage you to include those.

title: YouTube Automation Video Editor – Vidrush AI Workflow
description:
YouTube Automation Video Editor – Vidrush Workflow



My name is Rick, and we are scaling a network of YouTube channels focused on historical, cultural, food, and educational storytelling.



Example style reference only, not our channel:



youtu.be/6jZ7ib2Edes?si=acf8y118MfbnDNNE



We are looking for a reliable YouTube automation editor to create and release one long-form video per day using **Vidrush**.



Vidrush handles the majority of the production process, including assembling the voiceover, visuals, music, transitions, and basic video structure. Once familiar with the workflow, each video usually takes approximately **one hour from start to finish**.



This is not a traditional edit-from-scratch position. Your focus will be using Vidrush efficiently, improving the most important sections, correcting obvious visual mistakes, and preparing the video for release.



## Your Responsibilities



• Use Vidrush to create the video using the supplied script, voiceover, and channel instructions.



• Improve the **first two minutes** with stronger visuals, pacing, sound design, transitions, and pattern interruptions.



• Make sure the opening matches the promise of the title and keeps viewers watching.



• Replace clearly incorrect, unrelated, repetitive, low-quality, or poorly matched clips.



• Check that locations, historical periods, people, cultures, food, and events are represented accurately.



• Complete a final quality check for visual errors, repeated footage, black screens, audio problems, awkward transitions, and export issues.



• Export and release one completed video per day.



You are not expected to rebuild or manually clean up every section of the video. The goal is to focus on the improvements that will have the biggest impact on retention and overall quality.



## Position Details



• Schedule: Monday to Saturday

• Output: One video per day

• Video length: Usually 20–40 minutes

• Average workflow time: Approximately one hour per video once trained

• Pay: **$200 USD per month** paid bi weekly or monthly 

• Performance bonuses for exceptional results

• Long-term opportunity with room for increased pay and responsibilities



## Requirements



• Experience editing YouTube automation, faceless, documentary, educational, historical, cultural, or food content.



• Strong understanding of YouTube hooks, pacing, retention, and visual storytelling.



• Ability to improve the first two minutes of a long-form video.



• Ability to identify and replace inaccurate or unrelated footage.



• Comfortable using AI production tools and learning new workflows quickly.



• Reliable, organised, responsive, and able to work independently.



• Available Monday to Saturday and able to release one video per day.



Vidrush Research Required



Please research **Vidrush** before applying.



You do not need previous Vidrush experience, but you must understand the basic workflow and be confident that you can learn the platform quickly.



## How to Apply



To show that you have read the full job description, include the word **mango** in your application.



Please send:



1. Two or three examples of long-form YouTube videos you have edited.



2. A brief explanation of your experience with YouTube automation or faceless videos.



3. Your understanding of how Vidrush works after researching the platform.



4. How you would improve the first two minutes of a completed Vidrush video.



5. How you would identify and replace incorrect or poorly matched clips.



6. Confirmation that you can work Monday to Saturday and release one video per day.



7. Confirmation that you accept the monthly salary of $200 USD



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to short-form editing. We are looking for someone who understands long-form YouTube storytelling, retention, visual accuracy, and efficient AI-assisted production.

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Position Overview

The Operations Assistant is a critical execution role that empowers the company to design world-class operational systems by handling documentation, data management, process tracking, and administrative support. You'll be the operational backbone of the company - the person who turns strategic designs into documented, tracked, and continuously improving processes.

You ensure the systems we design are documented, organized, accurate, and accessible. You are organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and thrive when given clear specifications and ownership of execution.

What You'll Do

Core Responsibilities

1. DOCUMENTATION & PROCESS MANAGEMENT

Transform the Operations Architect's process designs and business logic into polished, professional Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Capture current-state processes by interviewing department owners and observing operations

Create and maintain a centralized documentation library with version control, change logs, and a master index

Proactively identify undocumented processes and flag them for prioritization

Maintain an "Opportunities Log"—as you document processes, identify and capture potential improvements (separate from approved SOPs)

Update SOPs when processes change, maintaining version history so teams know what's new

Deliverable: 2-3 finalized SOPs per week once templates and process flows are approved

2. DATA MANAGEMENT & DASHBOARDS

Set up and maintain dashboards per the Operations Architect's KPI framework specifications

Pull data daily from business systems, input into dashboards, and verify accuracy

Monitor dashboard alerts for anomalies and flag issues to the Architect immediately

Create detailed weekly data quality reports showing accuracy %, missing data, alerts, and confidence level

Document data sources and flag when sources change (so metrics remain comparable)

Ensure 99%+ data accuracy—dashboards are only useful if numbers are trustworthy

3. PROCESS MONITORING & COMPLIANCE TRACKING

Create and maintain compliance checklists for each SOP to track whether teams are following approved processes

Monitor adherence to processes and document exceptions with context (date, process, reason, department)

Flag recurring issues or bottlenecks to the Architect with evidence and frequency

Report weekly on process compliance metrics and identify systemic issues

4. TASK & PROJECT TRACKING

Attend all meetings and document decisions, action items, owners, due dates, and blockers using a standard template

Maintain a master Decisions Log showing what was d
, who owns it, when it's due, and current status

Maintain a master Project Tracker showing all initiatives: timeline, dependencies, current status, blockers, next milestones

Track all blockers and escalate immediately so the Architect can unblock issues

Send weekly task status reports to the team and Architect

Maintain a Pain Points & Opportunities Log to feed the 90-day roadmap

5. TEAM COORDINATION & COMMUNICATION

Schedule and prepare materials for the Architect's discovery interviews with department leaders

Coordinate tea
etings, send invites, and prepare meeting materials

Support process change rollouts by drafting communications (per Architect's direction) and distributing to teams

Collect and compile team feedback after new processes launch (via surveys, 1-on-1s, or observations)

Follow up with teams on decisions, action items, and process adoption

6. RESEARCH & ANALYSIS SUPPORT

Research tools, platforms, and vendors per the Architect's specifications; create comparison sheets

Gather best-practice research, case studies, and competitive intelligence to inform process design

Compile and organize data that the Architect needs to analyze (e.g., time waste by process, error patterns)

Research industry standards and how peer companies structure operational systems

Present findings in digestible, one-page summaries so the Architect can incorporate ideas quickly

7. ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT & SYSTEMS SETUP

Set up business systems per Architect specifications (Google Drive folder structure, tool configurations, user access)

Maintain the Architect's calendar, manage schedule coordination, and handle meeting logistics

Track tool subscriptions, software licenses, and administrative expenses

Maintain a centralized Project Operations Manual—organizing all approved SOPs, KPIs, dashboards, org charts, and workflows

Manage files, organize deliverables, and ensure nothing falls through cracks



Success Metrics (How We'll Measure Your Performance)

KPI

Target

Deadline

SOPs Completed & Formatted

2-3 fully finalized SOPs per week

Ongoing (starting Week 5)

Data Accuracy Score

99%+ accuracy on all dashboard data

Ongoing (starting Week 8)

On-Time Deliverables

100% of assigned deliverables completed on or before deadline

Ongoing

Process Compliance Reporting

Weekly report with 100?curacy (zero missed exceptions)

Ongoing (starting Week 8)

Documentation Currency

100% of SOPs reflect current processes; no outdated versions in use

Ongoing

Meeting Coordination Efficiency

100% of scheduled meetings happen on time with all materials prepared

Ongoing

Proactive Issue Flagging

Escalate blockers immediately when identified; no surprises

Ongoing

Team Feedback on Documentation

4+/5 rating from teams on SOP clarity and usefulness

Month 3+





Reporting Structure

Reports To: Operations Architect 

Supervision: Operations Architect reviews your work for accuracy, completeness, and quality before documentation goes live

Who Should Apply

Required Skills & Experience

3+ years of experience in operations, administrative support, project coordination, or process management

Obsessive attention to detail — You catch errors, inconsistencies, and missing information

Expert in Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive, Gmail) and Microsoft Office

Excellent written communication — SOPs and documentation must be clear, professional, and complete

Proven project tracking & organization skills — You thrive maintaining multiple tracking sheets, deadlines, and systems

Proactive problem-solving — You identify issues before they become problems and escalate appropriately

Ability to work independently — You don't need constant supervision; you own your deliverables

Ideal Background

Experience documenting processes (SOPs, procedures, workflows)

Experience with dashboards, data management, or analytics tools (Google Sheets, Excel, Looker, or similar)

Background in operations, business analysis, or management consulting

Experience in fast-growing or scaling companies where processes need to be built from scratch

Comfort with ambiguity early (things will be unclear initially; you'll help bring clarity)



Soft Skills We're Looking For

Ownership mentality — You don't just complete tasks; you own outcomes

Curiosity — You ask good questions to understand the "why" behind processes

Collaboration — You work well with teams across departments and bring people together

Humility — You know what you don't know and ask for help

Systems thinking — You see how processes connect and impact each other

Bias toward action — You get things done without waiting for perfect information

Compensation & Benefits

Pay Rate: Competitive based on experience (will be discussed during interview)

Location: Remote (working hours align with Eastern Time, Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM ET)

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Growth Path: As the company scales, you may transition to building an operations team where you'd manage other coordinators or specialists

Job Title: AutoCAD Drafter / 3D Modeler — Architectural Millwork (Remote, Long-Term)



About Us

Visual Millwork, Inc. is an AWI Premium Grade certified custom architectural millwork, metalwork, and stonework company . We design, fabricate, and install high-end interiors for hospitality, healthcare, retail, and corporate clients. We're looking for a detail-oriented drafter to join our team long-term as a dedicated remote resource.

Build 3D models of proposed millwork pieces for client presentations and shop reference

Nice to Have



Prior experience in millwork, cabinetry, or furniture manufacturing drafting specifically

Familiarity with AWI (Architectural Woodwork Institute) standards

Experience producing drawings for laminate, veneer, solid surface, or stone materials

Portfolio that includes shop drawings, not just architectural renderings



What We Offer

Opportunity to grow with an established, century-old company expanding its remote design capacity

title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist (Part-Time, could become full time))
description:
Media Buyer / Creative Strategist (Part-Time, 10-12 hrs/week)



We're a fast-growing B2B e-commerce brand selling premium pilates supplies to studio owners in the Netherlands, Belgium, the UK, Germany, and the USA. We went from €1,500/month to €113,000/month in under a year, and currently run around €10K/month in Meta Ads spend across these markets.



This is B2B lead generation media buying, not D2C. We're not optimizing for checkout conversions, we're optimizing for qualified leads from studio owners.



We're looking for someone who already runs Meta Ads lead gen campaigns and reads data like a second language: hook rate, CTR, CPL by creative, budget pacing, audience testing. You and our designer are direct partners: together you'll figure out what's working, what to scale, and where to iterate. You bring the data, they bring the creative, and the decisions come out of that back and forth.



If you can also design a static yourself, that's a welcome bonus, not a requirement.



What You'll Do:

- Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns across multiple markets (NL, BE, UK, DE, USA).

- Read performance data (hook rate, CTR, CPL, CPM, frequency, ROAS) and turn it into decisions: scale, pause, duplicate, retest.

- Partner closely with our designer: together you figure out what's working, what to scale, and what to iterate on. You bring the data, they bring the creative instinct.

- Manage budget pacing and audience testing inside Ads Manager.

- Report weekly on what changed, what you tested, and what's next.



What We're Looking For



Must-haves:



- Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads lead gen campaigns with a real budget, not just a course certificate.

- You can read a results table and tell us what it means, not just what it says.

- You understand creative strategy: you can talk through a hook, an audience, and an awareness level with a designer as a peer, not just hand off a brief.

- Comfortable with direct feedback, both giving and receiving.

- Working-level English, written and spoken.



Strong pluses:



- You can design a static creative yourself.

- Experience with Advantage+ Sales Campaigns / CBO structures.

- Experience running campaigns for European B2B or DTC audiences.



Who You'll Work With

- Jesse, our founder. Hands-on, fast-moving, built this from zero.

- Quincy, our marketing advisor. Direct communicator on data optimization and awareness-stage thinking.

- Our designer, your direct partner. You bring the data and testing ideas, they bring the creative execution, and you'll shape the next batch of ads together.

title: Rockstar Customer Service & Dispatch Coordinator for Fast Growing Service Business

mber who is excellent on the phone, highly organized, and knows how to stay on top of details in a fast paced service business.

What We’re Looking For

* Very organized

* Detail oriented

* Fast to respond

* Calm under pressure

* Good at multitasking

* Proactive and reliable

* Comfortable solving problems

This Role IS For You If

Palmway Pools is growing quickly, and we want long term tea
mbers.

title: Short-Form Video Editor - (AI Native)
description:
I run a daily TikTok LIVE series called "Mornings with Hakim"  a 1 to 1.5-hour live show on Singapore real estate, where viewers ask questions about property upgrading, finances, and market analysis. I need an editor who can turn each LIVE session into 5–10 punchy short-form clips for TikTok, posted same-day.



This is not a traditional editing role. The most important skill is identifying which 
nts to clip, the best Q&A exchanges, the sharpest insights, the 
nts viewers would share. The editing itself is clean and minimal: tight cuts, remove pauses and filler words, add captions. No sound effects, no trending 
s, no flashy transitions.



What You'll Do



Receive raw LIVE recordings daily (provided by me)

Use Claude AI to process transcripts, identify the strongest clippable segments, and draft captions

Cut 5–10 short-form vertical clips per session (1080×1920)

Clean up each clip — remove dead air, filler words ("uh," "um," "right right"), and awkward pauses

Add clean, readable captions

Deliver same-day (morning LIVE ? clips ready by evening)



What I'm Looking For



You are AI-native, you use tools like Claude AI as part of your actual workflow, not as a novelty. I'll want to see how you use AI to speed up clipping decisions, transcript analysis, and content selection

You have a good eye (and ear) for what makes a compelling short-form clip, pacing, hook, payoff

You're reliable on a daily cadence. This is an almost-everyday commitment

Editing software is your choice, CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci, whatever gets the job done

Experience with real estate, finance, or educational/talk-show content is a plus but not required



Compensation



SGD $500–$600/month



To Apply



Tell me:



What AI tools do you currently use in your editing workflow, and how?

Send me a sample of a long-form video you've clipped into short-form (yours or a test clip — either works)

Your typical turnaround time from raw footage to finished clips
