title: Short-Form Video Editor — High Volume, Core Team Role (Room to Grow)
description:
We're FaberX, an
 & SMS marketing agency for e-commerce brands. We publish a high volume of short-form video — talking-head clips and screen-recorded 
 teardowns" (breaking down real brand
s and showing what we'd build instead).



This is a core team role, not a one-off gig. We're looking for someone hungry, fast, and reliable who wants to grow with us and become a central part of the team.



You'll turn out a high volume of short vertical videos — up to around 30 a day. Some are simple (the benchmark is roughly 5 minutes to cut a clean 1-minute vertical); some are more involved when you're sourcing overlays, b-roll, or assets. And if you can prove you deliver quality at scale, there's the opportunity to take on longer-form YouTube editing in the future too.



HOW PAY WORKS

Pay is monthly and reflects your output and the complexity of the work — the more you produce at our standard, the more you earn. It starts in the $400–$650/month range depending on volume and complexity, with room to grow to $750+ for top performers and higher-paid YouTube edits later on. Final rate is agreed after a short trial. Tell me the rate you'd want when you apply.



THE TRIAL

Because this is competitive pay with genuine room to grow, shortlisted editors do a short trial first — a few sample edits (around 3 types of content I need) on our style — so I can see your speed and quality before we start. Only editors who hit the standard move forward.



WHAT A TYPICAL DAY LOOKS LIKE



Turn batches of raw footage into short vertical videos (9:16)

Mostly simple, fast edits: clean cuts, captions, basic b-roll/overlays

Some heavier edits when sourcing assets, overlays, or effects

Consistent style and quality across everything you deliver

Fast, reliable turnaround — volume matters here



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Fast, clean short-form editing (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) — show it in your portfolio

Someone hungry who wants a long-term, core role and will grow with us

Speed and consistency at volume, without dropping quality

Fluent with CapCut and/or Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve

Comfortable with captions, b-roll, overlays, and simple motion/text

Reliable, communicative, dependable, and takes feedback well

Reliable internet and a machine that handles editing smoothly



NICE TO HAVE



DTC / e-commerce or marketing/agency editing experience

Long-form / YouTube editing

Basic sound design and color correction



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

To apply, do all five:



Start your application with the word REELS so I know you read the full post.

Send a link to your portfolio or 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited (say what you did on each).

In 2–3 sentences, tell me: what makes a short-form hook actually work?

Tell me roughly how many simple 1-minute videos you can realistically edit in a day.

Tell me the rate you'd want (per video or per month) and how you'd prefer to be paid.



Applications that skip any of these, or that are copy-paste generic, won't be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants do a short trial before regular work.

title: SEO
description:
# Part-Time Technical SEO Engineer



**Compensation:** Starting at **$450/month (Part-Time)**



We're looking for an experienced **Technical SEO Engineer** to join our team.



This is **not** an entry-level SEO role.



If your experience is mainly keyword research, blog writing, or using SEO plugins, **please don't apply.** We're looking for someone with strong technical SEO knowledge who can confidently implement complex SEO improvements on a modern web application.



## About Us



We're building a rapidly growing online portal with thousands of users and an expanding inventory of dynamic pages. Our platform includes interactive maps, location-based content, structured data, user-generated content, AI-powered search features, and thousands of pages that need to be crawled, indexed, and optimized correctly.



As our platform continues to scale, technical SEO has become one of our highest priorities.



## Your Role



You will **not** be responsible for auditing the website or figuring out what needs to be fixed.



We already have an experienced SEO strategist who continuously audits the platform and provides a detailed list of technical SEO tasks. Your job is to implement those tasks efficiently and correctly.



Examples of tasks include:



* Fixing indexing issues

* Resolving crawl errors

* Implementing structured data (
 / JSON-LD)

* Improving internal linking

* Optimizing XML sitemaps

* Managing robots.txt

* Fixing canonical tags

* Optimizing metadata

* Improving Core Web Vitals

* Page speed optimization

* JavaScript SEO improvements

* Other technical SEO implementations



## Requirements



You should have experience with:



* Technical SEO

* HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

* Modern web frameworks (Next.js is a big plus)

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics

* XML Sitemaps

* robots.txt

* Canonical tags

* Structured Data (
 / JSON-LD)

* Core Web Vitals

* PageSpeed optimization

* Crawl optimization

* Indexing troubleshooting

* Large-scale website architecture



You should understand concepts such as:



* Crawl budget

* Rendering issues

* JavaScript SEO

* Server-side rendering (SSR) vs. client-side rendering (CSR)

* Duplicate content

* Dynamic routes

* Pagination

* Search engine crawling and indexing



## What We're Looking For



* Someone who can execute technical SEO tasks independently

* Strong coding skills

* Clean, production-ready work

* Attention to detail

* Fast execution

* Excellent communication



## Long-Term Opportunity



This starts as a **part-time position at $450/month**, with compensation based on experience. We're looking for someone to become a long-ter
mber of our engineering team.



If you consistently deliver high-quality work and help improve the technical SEO of our platform, we'd love to continue working with you for years as the platform grows. There will be opportunities for increased compensation, additional responsibilities, and a larger role within the team.



## To Apply



Please include:



* Your resume

* A brief summary of your technical SEO experience

* Examples of websites or platforms you've worked on

* Experience with large-scale websites or web applications

* Your GitHub or portfolio (if applicable)



**If you don't have strong technical SEO experience or coding experience, please don't apply. We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running from day one.**
